source: Each university's own international-admissions pages, read 2026-11-04 and rewritten in CAS's own words

anhui-medical-university.name: Anhui Provincial Government Scholarship (Study in Anhui)
anhui-medical-university.coverage: Yearly cash award: PhD 50,000, master's 30,000, bachelor's 20,000 RMB
anhui-medical-university.description: A provincial award administered by the university for full-time international students. It is a cash award only.
anhui-medical-university.eligibility: Full-time international students with a valid passport, proof of English and a current HSK certificate. Age limits: doctoral under 45, master's under 40, bachelor's under 28. Postgraduates need two professor recommendations.
anhui-medical-university.how_to_apply: Hold the university's pre-admission notice first; no separate scholarship form is described.

anhui-medical-university.name: AHMU China-ASEAN Silk Road Scholarship
anhui-medical-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and books, plus a first-year allowance
anhui-medical-university.description: Full scholarship for students from ASEAN countries; the first-year living allowance is 10,000 RMB and students may reapply in later years.
anhui-medical-university.eligibility: Full-time students from the ten ASEAN countries other than Timor-Leste, with a valid passport and proof of English. Age limits: bachelor's under 28, master's under 35, doctoral under 40. Holders of a Chinese Government Scholarship are excluded.
anhui-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply for admission and email the materials to the international education office.

capital-medical-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Capital Medical University)
capital-medical-university.coverage: Partial award from the Beijing programme, subject to the yearly quota
capital-medical-university.description: The university follows the Beijing Government Scholarship management measures for its English-taught undergraduate clinical medicine students. An earlier brochure described up to 20,000 RMB per year from the second year and 20,000 RMB for qualified new students; the 2026 brochure states no amount.
capital-medical-university.eligibility: Criteria follow the Beijing measures; the 2026 brochure lists none.
capital-medical-university.how_to_apply: No separate procedure is described; apply for the programme through the university's admissions system.

chongqing-medical-university.name: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship
chongqing-medical-university.coverage: Cash awards in two classes by level, 10,000 to 35,000 RMB a year
chongqing-medical-university.description: First and second class awards per year: doctoral 35,000 / 20,000, master's 30,000 / 15,000, bachelor's 25,000 / 10,000, Chinese-language course 10,000 / 8,000. About 20 to 30 awards a year; results usually come late May to mid-June.
chongqing-medical-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health. Age limits: bachelor's under 25 (high-school diploma), master's under 35, doctoral under 40, language training under 35. Open to new and current students.
chongqing-medical-university.how_to_apply: Consult the university's scholarship pages or international office; the listing gives no procedure.

fudan-university.name: Fudan University International Students' Scholarship
fudan-university.coverage: Awarded to excellent applicants by academic record and admission results
fudan-university.description: A merit scholarship for applicants to the Chinese-taught postgraduate programs; the guide does not say whether it reduces tuition or pays cash.
fudan-university.eligibility: Chosen from applicants on academic performance and the admission evaluation.
fudan-university.how_to_apply: No separate form; applicants are considered automatically.

fudan-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (through Fudan)
fudan-university.coverage: Master's stipend 3,000 and doctoral 3,500 RMB a month, as listed for the scholarship group
fudan-university.description: The guide groups it with the Chinese Government Scholarship benefits: tuition, housing or a housing subsidy, medical insurance and the monthly stipend. Shanghai's own amounts are not listed separately.
fudan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; master's applicants under 35, doctoral under 40; no other Chinese government scholarship.
fudan-university.how_to_apply: Complete and sign the Shanghai Government Scholarship form and upload it with the admission application in Fudan's online system.

fujian-medical-university.name: Fujian Medical University Scholarship (graduate)
fujian-medical-university.coverage: Tiered yearly cash awards, 10,000 to 45,000 RMB
fujian-medical-university.description: Master's first year: 40,000 / 20,000 / 10,000 RMB for the top 20% / next 20% / remaining 60%. Doctoral first year: 45,000 / 30,000 / 20,000 RMB on the same split. Later years use different shares. At least the third level is guaranteed in year one.
fujian-medical-university.eligibility: International master's and doctoral students enrolled at the university; the tier depends on a comprehensive assessment.
fujian-medical-university.how_to_apply: No application needed; students are considered automatically.

fujian-medical-university.name: Fujian Medical University monthly stipend (graduate)
fujian-medical-university.coverage: Monthly stipend: master's 1,000, doctoral 1,500 RMB for three years
fujian-medical-university.description: A monthly living stipend paid to graduate students for three academic years.
fujian-medical-university.eligibility: International master's and doctoral students at the university.

fujian-medical-university.name: Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship (via FJMU)
fujian-medical-university.description: A provincial award administered by the university. The fee sheet does not say which costs it offsets.
fujian-medical-university.eligibility: Open to international students who did not win a Chinese government scholarship.
fujian-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the college's online platform with an 800 RMB application fee; follow the College of Overseas Education site for details.

guangxi-medical-university.name: GXMU President Scholarship for Freshmen
guangxi-medical-university.coverage: Awarded to admitted self-funded undergraduates by admission score
guangxi-medical-university.description: A freshman award for self-funded undergraduates who are admitted, register and pay all fees; the brochure states no amount.
guangxi-medical-university.eligibility: Open to all nationalities, ranked by overall admission score.
guangxi-medical-university.how_to_apply: No separate application; eligible students are included automatically.

guangxi-medical-university.name: Guangxi Government Full Scholarship for ASEAN Students
guangxi-medical-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and books plus a monthly allowance
guangxi-medical-university.description: Covers tuition, on-campus housing, comprehensive medical insurance and textbooks, plus a monthly allowance (the 2024 notice gave 1,000 for bachelor's, 1,500 for master's and 2,000 RMB for doctoral students). Travel is the student's own cost.
guangxi-medical-university.eligibility: Citizens of ASEAN countries in good health studying Chinese-taught programs. Age: bachelor's 18 to 25, master's up to 35, doctoral up to 40. HSK 4 for bachelor's, HSK 5 for postgraduates. No other Chinese government scholarship.
guangxi-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply online through the international student system; the university reviews and interviews, then nominates candidates to the Guangxi education department. Applications are accepted March to May each year.

guangzhou-medical-university.name: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Students Scholarship for Freshmen
guangzhou-medical-university.coverage: One-off cash award: doctoral 30,000, master's 20,000 RMB
guangzhou-medical-university.description: A one-off cash payment into the winner's bank account after registration. It is not a fee waiver; winners still pay fees at the self-funded rate.
guangzhou-medical-university.eligibility: Self-supporting international master's and doctoral freshmen.
guangzhou-medical-university.how_to_apply: No separate process is described; contact the international office. The admission window runs 1 March to 30 June.

harbin-medical-university.name: MOE-Heilongjiang Joint Scholarship for Eurasian Countries
harbin-medical-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and a stipend of 3,000 (master's) or 3,500 (doctoral) RMB a month
harbin-medical-university.description: A joint national and provincial postgraduate scholarship; about 20 places in 2026 across all postgraduate programs. The university recommends candidates and the China Scholarship Council decides.
harbin-medical-university.eligibility: Citizens of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Moldova, Azerbaijan or Mongolia. Master's applicants under 35, doctoral under 40.
harbin-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the CSC online system as Type B using the university's code, with a study plan, two recommendations, language proof, a medical report, a police certificate and a supervisor's acceptance letter.

hebei-medical-university.name: HMU International Student Scholarship for Freshmen
hebei-medical-university.coverage: Cash award by class: bachelor's 8,000 to 36,000, master's 10,000 to 40,000, doctoral 30,000 to 50,000 RMB
hebei-medical-university.description: A new-student merit award in three classes (two for doctoral students). The page does not say which costs it offsets and gives its amounts only in a table from February 2025.

huazhong-university-of-science-and-techn.name: HUST President Scholarship (undergraduate)
huazhong-university-of-science-and-techn.coverage: One-time payment of 2,000 to 5,000 RMB in the first semester
huazhong-university-of-science-and-techn.description: A one-off award for new self-funded international undergraduates.
huazhong-university-of-science-and-techn.eligibility: Self-funded international undergraduates with strong high-school results and good overall qualities.
huazhong-university-of-science-and-techn.how_to_apply: No separate application; recipients are chosen from the admission materials.

jiangsu-university.name: JSU Presidential Scholarship
jiangsu-university.coverage: Tuition and housing (doctoral) or yearly cash award (master's and bachelor's)
jiangsu-university.description: For English-taught programs. Doctoral Type A covers tuition and housing plus a 5,000 RMB stipend; Type B covers tuition and housing. Master's awards are 25,000 (A) or 20,000 RMB (B); bachelor's 10,000 RMB (A: first year only; B: every year). Chinese-taught bachelor's applicants get a 40% tuition discount instead.
jiangsu-university.eligibility: English-taught programs only. Age: bachelor's under 25, master's under 30, doctoral under 40. Type A suits graduates of top-ranked universities, continuing students and listed new programs; Type B bachelor's is for listed countries. Graduate awards are reviewed yearly and cannot be combined with others.
jiangsu-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the Presidential Scholarship form and upload it with the online application.

jiangsu-university.name: Study in Jiangsu Government Scholarship (via JSU)
jiangsu-university.description: A one-time provincial cash award for continuing students.
jiangsu-university.eligibility: Full-time degree students in year two or above. Anyone who has held a Chinese Government or Jiangsu provincial scholarship cannot apply.
jiangsu-university.how_to_apply: Timing follows the Jiangsu Department of Education notice.

jilin-university.name: JLU Golden Bean International Students Scholarship
jilin-university.coverage: Cash award of 2,000 RMB per person
jilin-university.description: A donor-funded award; the 2024 round had 40 scholarships and 25 sponsorships, and nobody could receive both in a year.
jilin-university.eligibility: Scholarship: self-funded degree students in the top 10% of their major with at least 90% attendance and no failed exams. Sponsorship: students with financial difficulty and at least 85% attendance.
jilin-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the application form, get the college to sign it and submit it with supporting documents to the College of International Education; there is an interview. The usual window is November.

jinan-university.name: Guangdong Provincial Government Scholarship (via Jinan University)
jinan-university.coverage: Cash award of 10,000 RMB per year
jinan-university.description: A yearly cash award for continuing undergraduates.
jinan-university.eligibility: Full-time undergraduates under 40 in year two or above, with grades above 70, no failed courses, no other Chinese government scholarship, and proof of Chinese proficiency (may be relaxed for English-taught majors).
jinan-university.how_to_apply: Hand in the form, transcript, passport copy, language proof and a personal essay to your college, which nominates students; the province approves.

kunming-medical-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (via KMU)
kunming-medical-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and a monthly stipend of 1,400 to 2,000 RMB
kunming-medical-university.description: Covers tuition, housing and medical insurance for the standard length of the program, with a monthly stipend of 1,400 (bachelor's), 1,700 (master's) or 2,000 RMB (doctoral).
kunming-medical-university.eligibility: Foreign citizens in medicine-related majors with good conduct and grades. Age: bachelor's 18 to 25, master's 18 to 35, doctoral 20 to 45. Bachelor's applicants take the CSCA; Chinese-taught programs need HSK 4, English-taught IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 70. No other government or university scholarship.
kunming-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's international admission platform; there is a document check, a video interview and committee review, and the Yunnan education department approves.

kunming-medical-university.name: KMU Freshmen Financial Aid
kunming-medical-university.coverage: Monthly stipend over ten months: bachelor's 1,000, master's 1,700, doctoral 2,000 RMB
kunming-medical-university.description: A monthly stipend subject to monthly assessment and fees being paid; Chinese-language study 600 and medical advanced study 1,000 RMB a month.
kunming-medical-university.eligibility: First-year self-funded students paying full tuition.
kunming-medical-university.how_to_apply: Students apply and the university reviews; no window is stated.

kunming-medical-university.name: KMU Academic Scholarships
kunming-medical-university.coverage: Yearly cash awards for 70% of eligible students
kunming-medical-university.description: First class (10% of students), second (20%) and third (40%). English-medium bachelor's: 15,000 / 10,000 / 5,000 RMB. Master's and doctoral: 20,000 / 15,000 / 10,000 RMB.
kunming-medical-university.eligibility: Self-funded undergraduate and graduate students from year two. Awards weigh exams or research (70%) and conduct (30%), with all fees paid and the annual assessment passed.

nanjing-medical-university.name: NMU Scholarship for Excellent International Students (graduate)
nanjing-medical-university.coverage: Quota and amount set each year by the university
nanjing-medical-university.description: A merit scholarship for graduate students who have studied at least a year at the university, scored on a social part and an academic part.
nanjing-medical-university.eligibility: Full-time international graduate students after at least one year of study; students on extended study, with discipline warnings or failed exams are excluded.
nanjing-medical-university.how_to_apply: Submit the form and materials to the School of International Education; a committee ranks applicants and the list is announced with an appeal route.

nanjing-medical-university.name: NMU Tuition Scholarship for undergraduates in Chinese-taught courses
nanjing-medical-university.coverage: Full, half or quarter tuition by yearly grade average of 90, 80 or 70
nanjing-medical-university.description: A tuition award for undergraduates after their first year; the page gives no money amounts.
nanjing-medical-university.eligibility: Full-time undergraduates with at least a year in Chinese-taught courses; holders of a Chinese government scholarship are excluded; year-three completers need HSK 4 at 180 or above.
nanjing-medical-university.how_to_apply: No form; the school compiles a list from grade statistics each September and a committee reviews it.

nantong-university.name: Nantong University International Students Scholarship
nantong-university.coverage: Five types, from free housing and part-tuition waivers to tuition, housing and allowance
nantong-university.description: Types: free on-campus housing; 30 to 50% tuition waiver; full tuition waiver; tuition plus housing waiver; tuition, housing and a monthly allowance. Applies from bridging to doctoral level.
nantong-university.eligibility: Good conduct and health, no other scholarship for the same period. Age: bachelor's under 30, master's under 35, doctoral under 45. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs, English proof for English-taught ones.
nantong-university.how_to_apply: Submit the admission application by 30 June each year; winners get their admission notice by the end of July.

ningbo-university.name: Ningbo University Scholarship
ningbo-university.coverage: Master's and doctoral about 30,000 RMB, bachelor's 10,000 RMB
ningbo-university.description: A university award; the page does not say what costs it covers.
ningbo-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health. Age: bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40. HSK or equivalent for Chinese-taught programs.
ningbo-university.how_to_apply: Hand in or mail the form, passport copy, notarized diploma and transcripts and health certificate to the International College admissions office.

ningbo-university.name: Ningbo Government Scholarship (via NBU)
ningbo-university.coverage: Master's and doctoral 30,000, bachelor's 20,000, Chinese-language students 6,000 RMB
ningbo-university.description: A city award; the page does not say whether the amounts are yearly.
ningbo-university.eligibility: Same basic conditions as the university scholarship, plus two recommendation letters for degree applicants.
ningbo-university.how_to_apply: Same paper-based process as the Ningbo University Scholarship.

qingdao-university.name: Qingdao University Presidential Scholarship
qingdao-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and a monthly allowance of 3,000 to 3,500 RMB
qingdao-university.description: Covers tuition, on-campus housing, living allowance and medical insurance for the period in the admission notice. In 2026 there were 5 places, all doctoral (3,500 RMB a month); in 2025 there were 20 doctoral and 10 master's places. Recipients pass an annual review and do 120 hours of volunteer work.
qingdao-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; master's under 35, doctoral under 40; one scholarship only.
qingdao-university.how_to_apply: Apply online, upload proof of the registration fee, then email the receipt and signed form to the admissions office.

qingdao-university.name: Qingdao Municipal Government Scholarship (Chinese Language bachelor's)
qingdao-university.coverage: First-semester tuition for new students; partial tuition waivers for continuing students
qingdao-university.description: New students receive full first-semester tuition. Continuing students ranked in the top 20% with at least 90% attendance get next year's first-semester tuition; those ranked 20 to 50% get a 5,000 RMB waiver.
qingdao-university.eligibility: Students in the Chinese Language bachelor's program.
qingdao-university.how_to_apply: New students add the Qingdao Municipal Government Scholarship form to their program application (April to June each year).

shandong-university.name: Shandong University Scholarship for Outstanding International Students
shandong-university.coverage: Full (tuition, allowance, housing, insurance) or partial (tuition and insurance)
shandong-university.description: Runs for the length of study stated in the admission letter. Results are announced by 1 August.
shandong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; strong academic record; no other Chinese government-funded scholarship. Chinese-taught programs need HSK 4 / 5 / 6; English-taught programs need IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80.
shandong-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's online system, filling in, signing and uploading the scholarship form.

shanghai-jiao-tong-university.name: SJTU Scholarship (undergraduate)
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.coverage: First class: full tuition and 2,500 RMB a month; second: half tuition; third: quarter tuition
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.description: Three tiers over four years; first class also includes a housing subsidy and insurance. The Shanghai Government Scholarship is merged into it. The figures are labelled estimates for 2027.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.eligibility: Admitted applicants judged excellent; no other scholarship at the same time.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.how_to_apply: Tick 'Apply for scholarship' in the online application; results come with the admission result.

shanghai-jiao-tong-university.name: SJTU Scholarship and Fellowship (graduate)
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.coverage: Full or partial tuition, with a housing subsidy tied to the level
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.description: Master's: SJTU Scholarship, tuition scholarships and school or college awards. Doctoral: SJTU Fellowship and Scholarship. No free dormitory is provided, only a subsidy.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.eligibility: Graduate applicants; recipients pass an annual review; only one channel (the university or an embassy) may be used.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.how_to_apply: Choose 'Apply for scholarships through SJTU' in the online application.

shantou-university.name: New International Student Scholarship of Shantou University
shantou-university.coverage: First prize: first-year tuition and housing; second: first-year tuition; third: half
shantou-university.description: For prospective undergraduates, not the Medical College programs. Winners pay the tuition in advance each September and the award is credited in the first year; only the highest award applies.
shantou-university.eligibility: Prospective undergraduate applicants; two recommendation letters.
shantou-university.how_to_apply: Apply to an undergraduate program through the online system or by email to the admissions office; the program deadline is 15 June.

shantou-university.name: Guangdong Government Scholarship (via Shantou University)
shantou-university.coverage: One-time award of 10,000 RMB for an undergraduate
shantou-university.description: A one-time cash award for self-funded international undergraduates in any program.
shantou-university.how_to_apply: The School of International Education announces the process, usually February to June.

sichuan-university.name: Study at SCU Outstanding Student Scholarship
sichuan-university.coverage: Undergraduate partial award; master's and doctoral full award with allowance
sichuan-university.description: Undergraduate up to 20,000 RMB a year. Master's and doctoral awards cover tuition, a housing subsidy, medical insurance and living expenses (up to 2,000 and 3,000 RMB a month). Clinical Medicine and Stomatology are excluded.
sichuan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese with a valid passport and good health; undergraduates about 18 to 22, master's under 30, doctoral under 35. Cannot be combined with Chinese government or other domestic funding; annual review applies.
sichuan-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the SCU International Student Application System; the Scholarship Review Committee selects within limited places.

soochow-university.name: Soochow University Scholarship
soochow-university.coverage: Full (with 3,000 or 3,500 RMB stipend) or partial (without stipend)
soochow-university.description: Full award: registration fee, tuition, housing, medical insurance and a monthly stipend (3,000 RMB for master's, 3,500 for doctoral). Partial award: the same without the stipend. Runs for the admitted study period.
soochow-university.eligibility: Master's and doctoral applicants under 35 and 40; HSK 5 for Chinese-taught programs or the English requirement for English-taught ones; annual review applies.
soochow-university.how_to_apply: Choose 'Soochow University Scholarship' in the International Student Service System and complete the online application.

southeast-university.name: Southeast University Scholarship (new students)
southeast-university.coverage: From part-tuition waivers up to full tuition plus 3,500 RMB a month
southeast-university.description: The scholarships page says awards range from full tuition plus a monthly allowance down to partial tuition waivers, without saying which tier applies.
southeast-university.eligibility: HSK 4 (200+) for Chinese-taught programs (HSK 5 for medical, humanities and economics/management); TOEFL 80 / IELTS 6.0 for English-taught programs; two recommendation letters and an 800-word research proposal.
southeast-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's application site and select the Southeast University Scholarship program.

tongji-university.name: Tongji University International Student Excellence Scholarship
tongji-university.coverage: Full tuition waiver and insurance; doctoral allowance 5,000 RMB a month
tongji-university.description: For high-level doctoral students, partner-university exchange students and English-taught undergraduates. Doctoral awards add housing or a 3,000 RMB off-campus subsidy, a 5,000 RMB monthly allowance and a 12,000 RMB graduation travel grant. Undergraduates receive 2,500 RMB a month.
tongji-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Undergraduates 18 to 25, doctoral and exchange students up to 40. Doctoral applicants need a master's degree, a strong research record and a supervisor's acceptance. HSK 5 for Chinese-taught, TOEFL 85 or IELTS 6.5 for English-taught programs. No other Chinese government scholarship.
tongji-university.how_to_apply: Apply online through the university's international admission system and upload the documents; selection is mainly by documents, with possible interviews.

tongji-university.name: Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship (via Tongji)
tongji-university.coverage: Category A: tuition, insurance, housing subsidy and a monthly allowance; Category B: tuition and insurance
tongji-university.description: Category A allowance is 2,500 RMB a month for bachelor's, 3,000 for master's and 3,500 for doctoral students. Joint degree promotion programs and English-taught undergraduate programs are excluded.
tongji-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; age limits 25 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral); no other scholarship.
tongji-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and choose the Shanghai Government Scholarship program; a non-refundable 600 RMB fee applies. The fall 2027 window is December 2026 to March 2027.

wenzhou-medical-university.name: Wenzhou Medical University Scholarship (postgraduate)
wenzhou-medical-university.coverage: Tuition waiver for three years; allowance of 2,500 to 3,000 RMB a month for doctoral
wenzhou-medical-university.description: Master's: tuition waived for three years. Doctoral: tuition waived plus 3,000 RMB a month. Combined master-doctoral: tuition waived for 2+3 years with 2,500 then 3,000 RMB a month. Housing and other costs are self-paid.
wenzhou-medical-university.eligibility: The page lists no criteria and points to the postgraduate admissions brochure.
wenzhou-medical-university.how_to_apply: Register and upload materials on the university's International Student Service Platform.

wenzhou-medical-university.name: Wenzhou Medical University MBBS scholarships
wenzhou-medical-university.coverage: Freshman awards of 5,000 to 20,000 RMB; yearly academic awards of 1,000 to 5,000 RMB
wenzhou-medical-university.description: A freshman entrance award in three tiers (20,000 / 10,000 / 5,000 RMB) by entrance-exam ranking, and yearly academic awards for MBBS years two to six (5,000 / 2,000 / 1,000 RMB), with a 20,000 RMB Zhejiang Government award on the same evaluation basis.
wenzhou-medical-university.eligibility: Freshmen are ranked by entrance results and must first pay full tuition; years two to six are assessed by yearly comprehensive evaluation.
wenzhou-medical-university.how_to_apply: No separate process is described; payment follows an official notice.

wuhan-university.name: Wuhan University Academic Freshman Scholarship
wuhan-university.coverage: One-time award: bachelor's 4,000, master's 6,000, doctoral 8,000 RMB
wuhan-university.description: Paid after first-semester registration; up to 100 awards a year, about 80 bachelor's and 20 master's or doctoral. The list is published by 30 June.
wuhan-university.eligibility: Self-funded new degree students meeting admission and language requirements (HSK 4 or 5, or TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5). Excludes students funded by the Chinese or a foreign government, a Confucius Institute or a company.
wuhan-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and select a major, uploading passport, degrees, transcripts, language certificate, statement, recommendations, medical form, proof of funds and a police certificate. The window is 5 March to 20 May each year.

wuhan-university.name: Wuhan University Advanced Student Freshman Scholarship
wuhan-university.coverage: One-time award: 2,000 (one semester) or 4,000 RMB (one year)
wuhan-university.description: For self-funded first-year non-degree advanced students; up to 100 a year.
wuhan-university.eligibility: Meet admission and language requirements (HSK 4 for Chinese-taught, TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5 for English-taught). Excludes students funded by the Chinese government or another organisation.
wuhan-university.how_to_apply: Apply online with passport, language results, study plan, proof of funds, police certificate and medical form; the window runs 5 March to 30 May each year.

xian-jiaotong-university.name: XJTU Siyuan International Student Scholarship (postgraduate)
xian-jiaotong-university.coverage: Tuition waiver plus a monthly living allowance
xian-jiaotong-university.description: Housing and medical insurance are not included. Subject to annual review.
xian-jiaotong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese with an ordinary passport and good health; master's applicants under 35, doctoral under 40; no other scholarship.
xian-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: Apply online through the international student system, then pay the non-refundable 800 RMB fee after initial review.

xian-jiaotong-university.name: XJTU International Undergraduate Freshman Scholarship
xian-jiaotong-university.coverage: First-year tuition waiver from 100% down to 10% in five tiers
xian-jiaotong-university.description: Tiers are 100%, 75%, 50%, 25% and 10% of tuition. Later years are reviewed on academic performance.
xian-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the online system; an 800 RMB fee applies to scholarship applicants.

xian-jiaotong-university.name: XJTU-Xi'an City Government Belt and Road Scholarship
xian-jiaotong-university.coverage: Bachelor's 15,000, master's 20,000, doctoral 25,000 RMB a year
xian-jiaotong-university.description: Master's and doctoral awards come with a full XJTU tuition waiver; non-degree stays of six months or more receive 1,000 RMB a month. Annual review applies.
xian-jiaotong-university.eligibility: Citizens of Belt and Road countries with HSK 4 or above. Age: bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40, non-degree under 45. No other scholarship.
xian-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: Apply online directly to the university.

xiamen-university.name: Xiamen University Scholarship for New International Students
xiamen-university.coverage: First class: full tuition and allowance; second: full tuition; third: half tuition
xiamen-university.description: 2027 intake. First-class allowance is 2,500 RMB a month for bachelor's, 3,000 for master's and 3,500 for doctoral students. Duration follows the program, with an annual review.
xiamen-university.eligibility: Already admitted to the university. Age on 1 September: bachelor's under 25, master's under 40, doctoral under 45. Selection weighs academic record, language, merit, research and supervisor comments.
xiamen-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and upload the signed scholarship form; no paper mailing. The window is 1 December 2026 to 30 April 2027.

xuzhou-medical-university.name: XZMU Excellent Freshman Scholarship (undergraduate)
xuzhou-medical-university.coverage: All or part of first-year tuition
xuzhou-medical-university.description: MBBS awards of 33,000 / 16,500 / 8,250 RMB, nursing 30,000 / 25,000 / 20,000 and dental 18,000 / 13,000 / 8,000 RMB (from a 2023 notice, so amounts may have changed). Housing and registration fees are not covered.
xuzhou-medical-university.eligibility: Full-time undergraduate applicants with a high-school diploma, strong results and a valid foreign passport; competition winners preferred; no other scholarship at the same time.
xuzhou-medical-university.how_to_apply: Decided from the admission application; no separate application is needed.

xuzhou-medical-university.name: XZMU Principal Fund Scholarship (master's and doctoral)
xuzhou-medical-university.coverage: 100% tuition plus a monthly allowance of 1,000 to 2,500 RMB
xuzhou-medical-university.description: Covers the full tuition (36,000 RMB a year for master's, 40,000 for doctoral) plus an allowance of 1,000 or 1,500 RMB a month for master's and 2,500 for doctoral students. From the 2025 brochure; the university may change details.
xuzhou-medical-university.eligibility: All admitted master's and doctoral students are eligible.

xuzhou-medical-university.name: Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship (via XZMU)
xuzhou-medical-university.coverage: Master's 70,000, doctoral 90,000 RMB a year; 30,000 for later-year students
xuzhou-medical-university.description: Awarded by the Jiangsu government; second-year and later awards of 30,000 RMB also depend on performance.
xuzhou-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply twice: in the university's international student system and on the Jiangsu Government Scholarship website.

yangzhou-university.name: Yangzhou University Scholarship (master's and doctoral)
yangzhou-university.coverage: Tuition and housing waiver plus a monthly living allowance
yangzhou-university.description: Master's lasts the standard study period; doctoral the standard period plus one year. Annual review each May, with results in June.
yangzhou-university.eligibility: Applicants to a master's degree aged 18 to under 35, or a doctoral degree aged 18 to under 40, with no similar scholarship in China.
yangzhou-university.how_to_apply: Apply together with the admission application; results are posted in the international student service system.

zhejiang-university.name: Zhejiang Government Scholarship (new international postgraduates)
zhejiang-university.description: Strong students may reapply; the award is lost on suspension or withdrawal.
zhejiang-university.eligibility: Meet postgraduate admission requirements, show solid grades, and hold no other scholarship at the same time.
zhejiang-university.how_to_apply: Apply in the online application system, uploading the scholarship form and a police certificate issued within six months; shortlisted candidates have a video interview.

zhejiang-university.name: KUKA Home International Student Scholarship
zhejiang-university.coverage: Awards of 15,000, 8,000 and 5,000 RMB for outstanding graduating students
zhejiang-university.description: Six awards: one first prize, two second prizes and three third prizes.
zhejiang-university.eligibility: Full-time international undergraduate and master's students about to graduate, with clean conduct and strong academics and activities.
zhejiang-university.how_to_apply: Email the form, supporting documents and a personal statement of at least 300 words as one ZIP file to the university's student office.

zhengzhou-university.name: Zhengzhou University President Scholarship
zhengzhou-university.coverage: Doctoral: full tuition, 1,000 RMB housing and 3,500 RMB stipend a month for four years
zhengzhou-university.description: Funds outstanding international postgraduates, especially doctoral students, for four academic years. Selection weighs the prior degree and institution, research output and proposal, language and test results, awards, and completeness of documents.
zhengzhou-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen in good health under 40 with a master's degree or higher and an excellent record, not already a registered doctoral student at a Chinese university. HSK 5 for Chinese-taught programs; IELTS 6.5 or higher for English-taught ones.
zhengzhou-university.how_to_apply: Submit the form, CV, passport, degrees and transcripts, a research proposal of at least 2,000 words, two recommendations, language scores, medical record and police clearance through the university's online application system. Intakes: applications 15 October to 15 December (March entry) and 1 March to 15 June (September entry); results follow 4 to 6 weeks later.

zhengzhou-university.name: Zhengzhou University Scholarships for Excellent International Students
zhengzhou-university.coverage: One-year cash awards of 12,000, 8,000 or 5,000 RMB, or 3,000 RMB for special merit
zhengzhou-university.description: A yearly merit award for enrolled students: the top 2% receive 12,000 RMB, the next 3% receive 8,000 and the next 5% receive 5,000; none renews. Ranking is 85% academic results and 15% conduct and activities.
zhengzhou-university.eligibility: Undergraduate or postgraduate students with more than a year of study, in the top 30% of their course results with attendance above 90%. Chinese Government Scholarship holders and students on extended study are excluded. Postgraduates also need a competition prize or an indexed paper or book.
zhengzhou-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the scholarship form and hand it to the Students Management Office; advisors rank the top 30% and the evaluation committee approves the list.

zhengzhou-university.name: Henan Government Scholarship (via Zhengzhou University)
zhengzhou-university.coverage: Partial: doctoral 40,000 RMB a year; master's tuition up to 30,000; bachelor's 15,000
zhengzhou-university.description: Henan funds international students at provincial universities, with no monthly allowance: doctoral 40,000 RMB a year for up to four years, master's tuition up to 30,000 a year for up to three, bachelor's 15,000 a year, language and scholar programs 5,000 a semester. It pays tuition only; any shortfall is the student's. The provincial education department makes the final decision.
zhengzhou-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no criminal record, new students only, with the matching prior qualification and language level. Age caps run from 25 (bachelor's) to 45 (doctoral). Holders of other government or sponsor funding such as CSC are not eligible.
zhengzhou-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's online application system and choose the Henan Province Government Scholarship; up to three universities may be applied to. The page's deadline text is inconsistent, so confirm the dates with the university.

beihua-university.name: Jilin Provincial Government Scholarship (Changbai Mountain Scholarship)
beihua-university.coverage: Master's: tuition, housing, insurance and living allowance for two years
beihua-university.description: A full provincial scholarship for full-time master's students, running two academic years of a three-year program, with intake each September.
beihua-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, 35 or under, with a bachelor's degree recognised by China's Ministry of Education, excellent grades, two professor recommendations and HSK 4 or equivalent. No other Chinese government scholarship.
beihua-university.how_to_apply: Email the application form and supporting documents as PDF files to the admissions office; the page gives no deadline.

southwest-medical-university.name: SWMU University Scholarship (postgraduate)
southwest-medical-university.coverage: 25,000 RMB a year, paid back after the tuition is paid
southwest-medical-university.description: Students pay the 25,000 RMB annual tuition first and the university then pays 25,000 RMB a year to each recipient, so it works as a tuition refund. The 2024 guide gives no further details.
southwest-medical-university.eligibility: No separate criteria; the postgraduate admission rules apply: age 18 to 40, a medical bachelor's degree or above, HSK 4 or above and English ability.
southwest-medical-university.how_to_apply: Apply for the postgraduate program by emailing the signed forms and documents to the international office.

southwest-medical-university.name: Sichuan Government Scholarship (via SWMU, postgraduate)
southwest-medical-university.description: The 2024 postgraduate admission guide lists a Sichuan Government Scholarship of 20,000 RMB a year and states nothing more about it.
southwest-medical-university.eligibility: Not stated separately; the general postgraduate admission requirements apply.
southwest-medical-university.how_to_apply: Not stated separately; use the postgraduate admission application.

university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.name: UESTC University Scholarship (Belt and Road Initiative Scholarship)
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.coverage: Class 1: tuition, housing, insurance and 1,500 RMB a month; lower classes cover less
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.description: UESTC's own scholarship for graduate degree students in three classes. Winners are picked during new-student recruitment and cannot be applied for after enrolment. It runs two years for master's and three for doctoral students. Taken from an older archived copy of the page, so terms may have changed.
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.eligibility: Non-Chinese applicants who qualify for admission, are healthy and law-abiding, and hold no other scholarship. Master's and doctoral only.
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.how_to_apply: Apply to a graduate program through the online international application system; selection happens during admission.

university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.name: Chengdu Sister Cities Scholarship (via UESTC)
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.coverage: Tuition, on-campus housing and insurance; undergraduate up to 4 years, doctoral up to 3
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.description: A Chengdu government scholarship for students from the city's sister cities. The university does the first review and the city gives final approval. From an older archived page.
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.eligibility: Foreign nationals born in, studying in, working in or living in a Chengdu sister city, with a confirmation letter from that city; meet the admission requirements; no other scholarship.
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec.how_to_apply: Submit documents through the online application system before arrival, or to the School of International Education after arrival; they then go to the Chengdu government.

peking-university.name: Peking University Scholarship for International Students
peking-university.coverage: Tuition, living stipend and medical insurance; renewable yearly after review
peking-university.description: The university's own merit scholarship for undergraduate, master's and doctoral students, set up in 2012. It lasts 4 years (undergraduate), 2 to 3 (master's) or 4 (doctoral) and is renewed each year if the annual review is passed.
peking-university.eligibility: Meets the admission requirements and applies to a full-time self-funded program; no other scholarship funding.
peking-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's international student portal; undergraduates need no separate form. Results are sent by email.

peking-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship for current students (Peking University)
peking-university.coverage: Type A: tuition, housing, stipend, insurance; Type B: no stipend; Type C: tuition and insurance
peking-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship for continuing international students, with Types A, B and C. Type C holders in year two or above can apply to upgrade.
peking-university.eligibility: Full-time foreign students in year two or above on programs with regular tuition; no other Chinese government, social organisation or university scholarship. Age limits 25 (undergraduate), 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral).
peking-university.how_to_apply: Log in to the student portal, open Scholarship Application, then Application for Current Students, and upload the official transcript and documents. The yearly window closes in September.

tsinghua-university.name: Tsinghua University Tuition Scholarship (graduate)
tsinghua-university.coverage: Full or partial tuition for one academic year; reapply yearly
tsinghua-university.description: The graduate admissions site lists tuition scholarships for international graduate students, including the Beijing Government Scholarship and the university's own tuition scholarship. They cover full or partial tuition for one year and are competitive.
tsinghua-university.eligibility: Outstanding full-time international graduate students; no further criteria are listed.
tsinghua-university.how_to_apply: Students may apply every year; see the scholarship application page on the graduate admissions site.

tsinghua-university.name: Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (2026 cohort)
tsinghua-university.coverage: One to two years of tuition plus a living allowance for Asian master's applicants
tsinghua-university.description: Offered by the Bai Xian Asia Institute to Asian applicants to Tsinghua master's programs. Recipients attend the institute's summer program in August 2027.
tsinghua-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese Asian citizens meeting the master's admission requirements, with academic excellence, leadership and good English; no other scholarship. Not open to Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants.
tsinghua-university.how_to_apply: Apply online for a 2026 full-time international master's program, then email the scholarship form with a three-minute video, English certificate, transcripts and a recommendation to the target department.

changan-university.name: San Qin International Student Scholarship of Shaanxi Province
changan-university.coverage: Yearly cash award: doctoral 25,000, master's 20,000, undergraduate 13,000 RMB
changan-university.description: A Shaanxi provincial scholarship for enrolled self-funded international students, administered by the university's international education school.
changan-university.eligibility: Registered self-funded full-time undergraduate, master's or doctoral students in year two or above with a clean conduct record and a B or above in current-year exams. Holders of other scholarships should not apply.
changan-university.how_to_apply: Submit the form, passport and visa copies and the current transcript; the deadline is announced on the school's website.

changan-university.name: Chang'an University Outstanding International Students Scholarship
changan-university.coverage: Tiered cash awards; amounts are shown only in an image on the page
changan-university.description: A university award for current international students with strong academic results and campus involvement.
changan-university.eligibility: Full-time self-funded undergraduate, master's or doctoral students in year two or above who passed all current-year exams, took part in cultural, sports or social activities and have no disciplinary violations.
changan-university.how_to_apply: Submit the form, an official transcript and copies of award certificates; the deadline is in a separate notice.

changan-university.name: Chang'an University Presidential Scholarship
changan-university.coverage: Monthly stipend of 1,500, 2,000 or 2,500 RMB for ten months; undergraduate hostel waiver
changan-university.description: For new degree students. The stipend is paid in the first year only; undergraduates also get a hostel-fee waiver on the Weishui campus. Tuition is self-funded.
changan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; no other scholarship; HSK or English proficiency, with exemptions for prior study in Chinese or English.
changan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's online system and select the Presidential Scholarship; pay the 400 RMB fee after preliminary review and submit the passport, diplomas, transcripts, medical form, police certificate, study plan and two recommendations.

changan-university.name: Chang'an University Innovation Scholarship
changan-university.coverage: Full tuition waiver plus a one-off 15,000 RMB living allowance
changan-university.description: For two four-year English-taught bachelor's programs (Applied Geology; Materials Science and Technology), 20 seats each. Selection is by documents and interview; recipients must pass an annual review. Housing is not covered.
changan-university.eligibility: Age 18 to 25, healthy, with a high-school diploma, a valid passport and IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 68.
changan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's admission system and pay the 400 RMB fee after preliminary approval; the window is 15 May to 30 June.

university-of-science-and-technology-of-.name: USTC Fellowship for Undergraduate Programs (2027 intake)
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.coverage: Full: tuition, insurance, monthly stipend and housing; partial: tuition only
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.description: The university's own scholarship for international bachelor's applicants, with a full level and a tuition-only level. Applicants with other Chinese funding for 2027-28 cannot apply.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.eligibility: Under 25 on 1 September 2027 and meeting the 2027 undergraduate admission requirements.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.how_to_apply: Create an account in the online application system, choose a bachelor's program, complete the form and upload documents; check the email for supplement requests and interview invitations.

university-of-science-and-technology-of-.name: USTC Fellowship for Master's Programs (Type C and CAS-ANSO Type A)
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.coverage: Level A: tuition, insurance, stipend and housing; level B: tuition only
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.description: The university's own master's scholarship (Type C) in two levels. Type A (CAS-ANSO) has the same coverage as level A but different eligibility. Applicants may apply for several types but receive only one; no host supervisor is needed.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.eligibility: Type C: under 35 on 1 September 2027 and meeting the 2027 master's requirements. Type A: under 30 and not already in a master's program in China.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.how_to_apply: Create an account in the online application system, select the program and scholarship type, complete the form and upload documents.

university-of-science-and-technology-of-.name: USTC Fellowship for Doctoral Programs (Type C and CAS-ANSO Type A)
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.coverage: Level A: tuition, insurance, stipend and housing; level B: tuition only
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.description: The university's own doctoral scholarship (Type C) in two levels. Type A is the CAS-ANSO scholarship covering tuition, insurance and a stipend. Each applicant receives only one type; no host supervisor is needed.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.eligibility: Type C: under 40 on 1 September 2027. Type A: under 35, not enrolled in a doctoral program in China, and not also applying for CAS-ANSO at UCAS.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.how_to_apply: Create an account in the online application system, select the program and scholarship type, complete the form and upload documents.

beihang-university.name: Outstanding Talents Scholarship of Beihang University (freshman)
beihang-university.coverage: 100% tuition waiver, living allowance and on-campus housing
beihang-university.description: A freshman undergraduate scholarship for the 2027 intake; evaluation runs May to June 2027.
beihang-university.eligibility: Current-year high-school graduates with an excellent record and conduct, a strong admission assessment and a school recommendation; honours, patents or provincial culture or sports prizes may earn priority.
beihang-university.how_to_apply: Submit scholarship materials through the online application system together with the admission application; without them you are treated as not applying.

beihang-university.name: Program and Cooperation Foreign Students Scholarship (undergraduate)
beihang-university.description: For undergraduates recommended by institutions with a cooperation agreement with the university; evaluated May to June 2027.
beihang-university.eligibility: Current-year high-school graduates with an excellent record and conduct and a recommendation from a domestic or overseas partner institution.
beihang-university.how_to_apply: Submit scholarship materials through the online application system together with the admission application.

beihang-university.name: Beihang University Scholarship for International Students (freshmen)
beihang-university.description: A merit scholarship for new undergraduates, decided at admission; evaluated May to June 2027.
beihang-university.eligibility: Applicants with an excellent high-school record and conduct and a strong admission assessment.
beihang-university.how_to_apply: Submit scholarship materials through the online application system together with the admission application.

beihang-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Beihang undergraduate, Beijing campus majors)
beihang-university.coverage: Full tuition waiver plus insurance fee
beihang-university.description: A Beijing municipal full scholarship for freshmen on Beijing-campus majors, administered by the university; evaluated May to June 2027.
beihang-university.eligibility: Current-year high-school graduates with an excellent record and conduct and a strong admission assessment.
beihang-university.how_to_apply: Submit scholarship materials through the online application system together with the admission application.

beihang-university.name: Program and Cooperation Foreign Students Scholarship (self-supported, general rules)
beihang-university.coverage: Tuition cut by 20, 50, 80 or 100%, plus housing and living costs for some
beihang-university.description: The university's general scheme for new self-supported students recommended by partner institutions. Exchange students usually get tuition support only. Holders pass an annual review each May.
beihang-university.eligibility: New applicants must meet the recruitment rules and be recommended by a university, organisation, government department, embassy or consulate.
beihang-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the recommendation form, have the recommending institution approve it and submit it with the application form to the foreign student affairs office. Usual deadlines are 20 December (spring) and 25 May (fall).

hunan-normal-university.name: Hunan Province Scholarship for Foreign Students
hunan-normal-university.coverage: Yearly award: language 6,000, bachelor's 15,000, master's 20,000, doctoral 25,000 RMB
hunan-normal-university.description: A Hunan provincial scholarship for excellent foreign students; the amounts come from an older English page, as the 2022-23 brochure gives none.
hunan-normal-university.eligibility: Outstanding foreign undergraduate, master's and doctoral students studying in Hunan.
hunan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply directly to the university, usually in June and July.

hunan-normal-university.name: Hunan Province Belt and Road Scholarship
hunan-normal-university.coverage: Registration fee, tuition, housing and insurance for one year of Chinese study
hunan-normal-university.description: A Hunan provincial scholarship for one-year non-degree Chinese-language study; the quota is announced in June.
hunan-normal-university.eligibility: Applicants from Belt and Road countries.
hunan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply directly to the university, usually April to June.

hunan-normal-university.name: Hunan Normal University Scholarship for International Students
hunan-normal-university.coverage: Awards of 1,000 to 16,000 RMB depending on the program
hunan-normal-university.description: A university award for excellent international students; winners and quotas are announced in June or July.
hunan-normal-university.eligibility: Excellent current or prospective non-degree, undergraduate, master's and doctoral students.
hunan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply directly to the university, usually May to June.

hunan-normal-university.name: Hunan Normal University First-Class Discipline Scholarship
hunan-normal-university.description: For graduate students in designated first-class discipline majors, reviewed on a rolling basis.
hunan-normal-university.eligibility: Excellent international master's and doctoral applicants to first-class discipline majors.
hunan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Details are in a separate scholarship brochure; applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

east-china-normal-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (ECNU, graduate)
east-china-normal-university.coverage: Type A: tuition, housing, stipend of 3,000 or 3,500 RMB, insurance; Type B: tuition and insurance
east-china-normal-university.description: A Shanghai municipal scholarship for master's and doctoral students, awarded after pre-admission in a separate evaluation. A few master's programs in economics, management and teacher education are excluded.
east-china-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; master's under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK or English scores required.
east-china-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's application site, pay the 800 RMB fee and upload the scholarship form; the school reviews and may interview.

east-china-normal-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (ECNU, undergraduate)
east-china-normal-university.coverage: Type A: tuition, housing, 2,500 RMB a month, insurance; Type B: tuition and insurance
east-china-normal-university.description: A Shanghai municipal scholarship for Chinese-taught undergraduates; the university nominates recipients. Joint, English-taught and international Chinese studies programs are excluded.
east-china-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a high-school diploma, under 25, meeting the major's Chinese requirement.
east-china-normal-university.how_to_apply: Submit the online application and pay the 800 RMB fee; no separate scholarship application is needed.

central-south-university.name: Central South University Scholarship for International Students
central-south-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing and monthly stipend; partial: tuition only
central-south-university.description: The university's own scholarship for new master's (three years) and doctoral (four years) students, with an annual review. The 2026 round closed on 31 May 2026; no 2027 notice has been published yet.
central-south-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no criminal record. Master's: bachelor's degree, age 18 to 35. Doctoral: master's degree, age 18 to 40. HSK 4 (260+) or HSK 5 (200+) depending on field, or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 85. No other funding.
central-south-university.how_to_apply: Apply online, pay the 500 RMB fee after initial review, then the school reviews; documents include a one-minute video, two recommendations and a study plan of at least 1,000 words.

shaanxi-normal-university.name: Xi'an Municipal Belt and Road Scholarship (Shaanxi Normal University)
shaanxi-normal-university.coverage: Per person: doctoral 25,000, master's 20,000, bachelor's 15,000 RMB; language 1,000 a month
shaanxi-normal-university.description: A Xi'an city award for Belt and Road students run through the university. Awardees pay tuition, housing and insurance at registration and the grant is paid afterwards. The university interviews and recommends candidates; the city makes the final decision.
shaanxi-normal-university.eligibility: Ordinary passport from a Belt and Road country; no other scholarship. Age: doctoral under 40, master's under 35, bachelor's under 30, language under 45. Undergraduates need a CSCA transcript; HSK 4 or 5 for Chinese-taught programs.
shaanxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the university's online international-student system and upload the passport, notarised diplomas and transcripts, a study plan, two referee letters for graduate applicants, language certificate, police clearance, medical form and proof of funds.

shaanxi-normal-university.name: Five Central Asian Countries Scholarship (Shaanxi Normal University)
shaanxi-normal-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance, books, living allowance and a flight home
shaanxi-normal-university.description: A Xi'an government scholarship for students from five Central Asian countries on bachelor's (1+4 years), master's (3) and doctoral (3) programs starting September 2026. The university assesses applicants and recommends them to the city's education bureau.
shaanxi-normal-university.eligibility: Ordinary passport from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan or Uzbekistan; no other scholarship. Age: doctoral under 45, master's under 35, bachelor's under 25; undergraduates take the CSCA; HSK 4 or 5 for Chinese-taught programs.
shaanxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's online system and choose the Five Central Asian Countries scholarship; upload the form, study plan, passport, diplomas and transcripts, police clearance, recommendation, language certificate and medical form.

nanjing-agricultural-university.name: Jiangsu Provincial Government Distinguished Scholarship (NAU)
nanjing-agricultural-university.coverage: One-time award: 18,000 RMB for undergraduates, 30,000 RMB for postgraduates
nanjing-agricultural-university.description: For outstanding international students already studying at the university. For 2026 it could nominate 2 undergraduates, 4 master's and 1 doctoral student, through self-application, college approval, university review and a public posting.
nanjing-agricultural-university.eligibility: Degree students in year two or above who have paid fees and have no discipline record. Undergraduates need a GPA of at least 2.5; postgraduates 70 or more in every course. Not on suspension or extension and not a previous winner.
nanjing-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Log in to the international student service system and upload the transcript, the signed recommendation form, an HSK certificate if any, a story of at least 800 words about study in China and supporting awards.

east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (ECUST)
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, insurance and 3,000 or 3,500 RMB a month; class B: tuition and insurance
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.description: A Shanghai city scholarship handled by the university. Class A (master's and doctoral) is a full award; class B (all levels) covers tuition and insurance. A 1+4 undergraduate track gives a pre-university year, then four years of tuition and insurance.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.eligibility: Applicants to the university's degree programs; the 1+4 track is Chinese-taught only and needs HSK 3 or above.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.how_to_apply: Register on the application site, answer Yes for scholarship and pick the Shanghai Government Scholarship class, and pay the application fee.

east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.name: ECUST Scholarship for International Students (comprehensive and outstanding performance)
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.coverage: Comprehensive: 1,500 to 5,000 RMB; outstanding performance: 500 to 1,000 RMB
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.description: A yearly merit award for enrolled degree students, with each type capped at 5% of degree students; self-funded students get higher amounts than scholarship holders. Taken from an archived 2025 copy.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.eligibility: Degree students who studied at least a year, did not suspend or extend, have no discipline record and failed no more than two exams; GPA of 60 or above, rising to 75 to 80 for the comprehensive award.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.how_to_apply: Applications open each November; submit the form, last year's transcript and supporting materials.

east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.name: ECUST Scholarship for International Chinese Language Students
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.coverage: 1,000 RMB each semester (academic excellence or degree-study award)
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.description: A semester award for non-degree Chinese-language students. The academic excellence award needs 90 or above in every course; the degree-study award is for those admitted to a degree program. Winners cannot receive both.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.eligibility: Chinese-language students with at least 90% attendance; degree students, holders of other scholarships and tuition-exempt exchange students are excluded.
east-china-university-of-science-and-tec.how_to_apply: Assessed by a college panel after end-of-semester exams; no separate application is stated.

university-of-chinese-academy-of-science.name: UCAS Scholarship for International Students
university-of-chinese-academy-of-science.coverage: Full: tuition, 3,000 to 3,500 RMB stipend, housing, insurance; partial: tuition and insurance
university-of-chinese-academy-of-science.description: For master's, doctoral, visiting and joint-program students. Full awards cover tuition (doctoral 40,000, master's 30,000 RMB a year), a stipend of at least 3,500 RMB for doctoral and 3,000 for master's students, basic housing and insurance, with the 600 RMB application fee waived. Up to 36 months, no extension. The 2026 degree deadline was 31 January 2026.
university-of-chinese-academy-of-science.eligibility: Non-Chinese with a foreign passport and English or Chinese proficiency; born on or after 1 January 1991 (doctoral) or 1996 (master's); not already in a master's or doctoral program in China at the same level.
university-of-chinese-academy-of-science.how_to_apply: Apply in the online admission system and choose the UCAS Scholarship option; email master@ucas.ac.cn with questions.

tianjin-university.name: Tianjin University International Student Scholarship (bachelor's)
tianjin-university.coverage: One year: type A 20,000 RMB tuition plus 1,400 a month; B 20,000; C 10,000; D 6,000
tianjin-university.description: The undergraduate scholarship in four tiers (A to D), each lasting one year; amounts follow the admission notice.
tianjin-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, under 25, with a high-school diploma, good health and character. A CSCA transcript plus HSK 5 (180+) for Chinese-taught programs or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 for English-taught ones.
tianjin-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international student service system with the diploma, transcripts, CSCA score, passport, language proof, resume, a study plan of at least 600 words and the medical form. The 2026 deadline was 1 April.

tianjin-university.name: Tianjin University Scholarship in Chemical Engineering (English-taught bachelor's)
tianjin-university.coverage: Full: 20,000 RMB tuition subsidy plus 1,400 a month; partial: 20,000 RMB a year
tianjin-university.description: From the School of Chemical Engineering and Technology for its bachelor's program, four years subject to an annual review, with limited quotas.
tianjin-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, under 25, with a high-school diploma and good health; IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 unless a native English speaker.
tianjin-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international student service system with the standard undergraduate documents; the 2026 deadline was 1 April.

tianjin-university.name: Peiyang Future Scholar Scholarship (doctoral)
tianjin-university.coverage: Full: 38,000 RMB tuition, 3,500 RMB a month and free housing for three to four years
tianjin-university.description: A scholarship for doctoral students in any program, lasting the full 3 to 4 years; students who fail the annual review lose funding the next year.
tianjin-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, under 40, with a master's degree; HSK 5 (180+) for Chinese-taught programs or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 for English-taught ones.
tianjin-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international student service system with diplomas, transcripts, passport, language proof, a supervisor's acceptance letter and a research proposal of at least 1,000 words; the 2026 deadline was 31 May.

lanzhou-university.name: Lanzhou University President Scholarship
lanzhou-university.coverage: Not stated on the pages read
lanzhou-university.description: Set up in 2017 to recruit outstanding international students. The English page is an archived stub; the Chinese brochure gives eligibility and steps but no amount, coverage or deadline.
lanzhou-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no other scholarship. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, generally under 25; master's: bachelor's degree, under 35; doctoral: master's degree, under 40; plus a valid HSK certificate.
lanzhou-university.how_to_apply: Register on the university's application site and upload the form, a personal statement of at least 1,500 words, medical form, degrees and transcripts, referee letters for graduate applicants and passport, then post one printed set to the School of International Cultural Exchange.

heilongjiang-university.name: Heilongjiang University International College Scholarship (undergraduate)
heilongjiang-university.coverage: Four tiers: registration, tuition and housing; tuition; half tuition; 10% of tuition
heilongjiang-university.description: An entry scholarship for new undergraduates in two Chinese-taught majors, Chinese Language and Literature (4 years) and International Economics and Trade (5 years), renewed each year by review. Selection uses application materials plus an interview.
heilongjiang-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, 25 or under, with a high-school diploma, a CSCA score, no criminal record and no other scholarship.
heilongjiang-university.how_to_apply: Email the form, notarised diploma, transcripts, study plan, medical form, passport and police certificate to the admissions office by 5 June; offers go out in early July.

heilongjiang-university.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Scholarship (via Heilongjiang University)
heilongjiang-university.coverage: Tuition, shared dorm and comprehensive medical insurance
heilongjiang-university.description: A province-funded scholarship run by the international college; the provincial education department sets yearly quotas and approves recipients. The scheme page predates 2026.
heilongjiang-university.eligibility: Foreign nationality for at least four years. Bachelor's: high-school graduate, 25 or under; master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under; doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under; HSK 5 (180+); no other scholarship.
heilongjiang-university.how_to_apply: Applications usually open March to May; submit the provincial form, notarised credentials, HSK report, a study plan of 800 to 1,000 words, referee letters for graduates and the medical form.

heilongjiang-university.name: MOE-Heilongjiang Eurasian Countries Scholarship
heilongjiang-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, living allowance and insurance; master's and doctoral, 2027 to 2030
heilongjiang-university.description: A joint Ministry of Education and Heilongjiang program for master's and doctoral students from 13 Eurasian countries, applied for through the university. It is a named regional scheme, not the generic national scholarship.
heilongjiang-university.eligibility: Nationals of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Moldova, Azerbaijan or Mongolia. Master's 35 or under, doctoral 40 or under; grades above 75/100; no other scholarship.
heilongjiang-university.how_to_apply: Register in the CSC online system under the university's agency number, print and sign the form, and submit notarised credentials, transcripts, a study plan of at least 1,000 words, two professor letters and a passport copy.

heilongjiang-university.name: Heilongjiang University self-funded student scholarship
heilongjiang-university.coverage: Degree: 6,000, 4,000 or 2,000 RMB; non-degree: 1,000, 500 or 300 RMB
heilongjiang-university.description: Yearly merit awards for self-funded students already studying at the university, assessed each autumn; about 28% of assessed students receive one.
heilongjiang-university.eligibility: Self-funded foreign-passport holders with no other scholarship. Degree students: top 40% of class, lowest subject 80+, average 85+, over a year at the university. Non-degree: top 40%, each subject 85+, average 90+.
heilongjiang-university.how_to_apply: Assessed by the international college's scholarship committee each September and October (internal process).

nanjing-normal-university.name: Nanjing Normal University Scholarship
nanjing-normal-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend of 1,000, 1,500 or 2,500 RMB, insurance 800 RMB a year
nanjing-normal-university.description: A full scholarship for new international students on English-taught undergraduate programs and on master's and doctoral programs. A recipient cannot also hold a Chinese Government Scholarship.
nanjing-normal-university.eligibility: English-taught: TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5 or an English-medium prior degree. Chinese-taught: HSK 5 (180+) for master's, HSK 6 (180+) for doctoral. Postgraduates need two recommendations and a supervisor's acceptance.
nanjing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply online; the 2026 window was 1 March to 1 May and results were emailed in mid to late June.

nanjing-university-of-the-arts.name: Jiangsu Government Scholarship for International Students (via NUA)
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.coverage: 18,000 RMB for undergraduates; 30,000 RMB for master's or doctoral students; one year
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.description: Annual funding for degree students, with the university recommending applicants; it can be renewed by applying again each year.
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.eligibility: Degree students in year two or above; applicants submit the previous year's grades, awards and activities.
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.how_to_apply: Apply through the international education college with last year's academic record and activities; the university recommends the best candidates.

nanjing-university-of-the-arts.name: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship (via NUA)
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.coverage: 10,000 RMB bachelor's; 20,000 master's and doctoral; 5,000 non-degree trainee; one year
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.description: One-year funding for self-funded international students, including new students; it can be applied for every year.
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.eligibility: Self-funded international undergraduate, master's, doctoral or professional-training (a year or more) students.
nanjing-university-of-the-arts.how_to_apply: Choose the self-funded category in the online application; the category is changed if you are awarded. Details from the international education college.

shanxi-university.name: Shanxi University Undergraduate Scholarship (levels A and B)
shanxi-university.coverage: A: tuition, housing and 7,500 RMB a year living; B: tuition and housing
shanxi-university.description: For new international undergraduates in the 2026 bachelor's program. Majors listed: International Economics and Trade, Business Administration, Tourism Management, Chinese Linguistics and Literature, International Politics, Computer Science and Technology.
shanxi-university.eligibility: Level A: passed the CSCA, interview score 85+, HSK 4 of 220+. Level B: passed the CSCA, interview 75+, HSK 4 of 200+. General: non-Chinese, 25 or under, high-school certificate, transcript average above 85, HSK 4 of 180+.
shanxi-university.how_to_apply: Register in the international student system, choose the preparatory program, upload documents and attend the interview; the 2026 window was 1 December 2025 to 30 June 2026.

shanxi-university.name: Shanxi Government Scholarship Program for International Students
shanxi-university.coverage: Tuition and application fee waived, free housing and a living allowance
shanxi-university.description: A provincial scholarship for degree students at the university; the 2025 notice lists bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels.
shanxi-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese with no other scholarship. Doctoral: 40 or under, master's degree, GPA over 3.3/4, HSK 6 or English proof. Master's: 35 or under, GPA over 3.0/4, HSK 5 (200) or English proof. Bachelor's: 25 or under, average above 75, HSK 4 (220).
shanxi-university.how_to_apply: Register and apply online, upload documents with proof of 20,000 RMB in funds, then interview; results come within 15 working days.

china-agricultural-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (China Agricultural University)
china-agricultural-university.coverage: Level A: tuition, housing, living, insurance; B: no living allowance; C: tuition and insurance
china-agricultural-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship for new bachelor's, master's and doctoral students and outstanding self-funded students. Category 1 targets agricultural talent from Belt and Road and BRICS countries.
china-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; undergraduate under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK 4 for Chinese-taught or TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5 for English-taught programs; average 80/100 or GPA 3.0; undergraduates need a CSCA score of 80+.
china-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Register on the application site, choose the Beijing Government Scholarship, upload documents and pay the 400 RMB fee; the college interviews or examines applicants. The 2026 window was 8 May to 30 June.

nanchang-university.name: Jiangxi Provincial Government Scholarship (Nanchang University)
nanchang-university.coverage: Master's and doctoral: a one-time yearly payment; amount not stated
nanchang-university.description: A provincial scholarship for international degree and language students at the university or new entrants; the page gives no amount or dates.
nanchang-university.eligibility: Foreign passport, no other scholarship. Undergraduate under 28, master's under 35, doctoral under 45, language under 50; HSK or equivalent for Chinese-language applicants.
