nanchang-university.how_to_apply: Apply online with notarised credentials, transcript, passport copy, health and no-crime certificates, plus recommendations and a study plan for master's and doctoral applicants.

nanchang-university.name: Nanchang University President Scholarship
nanchang-university.coverage: Freshman, excellent undergraduate and graduate categories; amounts not stated
nanchang-university.description: A university scholarship for self-funded students in three categories: new undergraduates (class-based programs prioritised), undergraduates from year two, and master's and doctoral students.
nanchang-university.eligibility: Friendly to China, strong grades and good conduct.

chongqing-normal-university.name: Chongqing Normal University President Scholarship (2026)
chongqing-normal-university.coverage: First class: tuition, shared dorm, fees and 400 RMB a month; second class: tuition and fees
chongqing-normal-university.description: A university-funded scholarship for bachelor's, master's, doctoral and language students. First class for graduate students requires a completed year at the university; first-year graduates receive only second class.
chongqing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, friendly to China, no criminal record. Bachelor's: high school, 25 or under, CSCA required; master's 35 or under; doctoral 40 or under; language 18 to 50; HSK 4 or 5 by level; no other scholarship.
chongqing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the international student online service system and upload the form, credentials, transcripts, study plan, HSK, recommendations and medical form; the 2026 window was 1 March to 30 May.

chongqing-normal-university.name: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship (via CQNU)
chongqing-normal-university.coverage: 35,000 RMB doctoral, 30,000 master's, 25,000 bachelor's per year
chongqing-normal-university.description: A Chongqing municipal scholarship applied for through the university, payable for the normal length of each degree.
chongqing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no other scholarship. Bachelor's 25 or under with the CSCA; master's 35 or under; doctoral 40 or under; language 18 to 50.
chongqing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Use the same online system as the President Scholarship with the Mayor Scholarship form; the 2026 window was 1 March to 30 May.

shanghai-normal-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (Shanghai Normal University)
shanghai-normal-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, insurance, 3,000 or 3,500 RMB a month; class B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-normal-university.description: A Shanghai municipal scholarship run by the university. Class A is full funding for master's and doctoral students; class B is partial and open to bachelor's, master's and doctoral students.
shanghai-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, strong grades, no CSC award. Age under 25 / 35 / 40; Chinese-taught programs need HSK, English-taught IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 for postgraduates; the CSCA is required; art applicants submit four or five works.
shanghai-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site, upload the scholarship form and documents and pay 520 RMB; the 2026 window was 1 January to 31 May, with results by end of August.

shanghai-normal-university.name: SISP Scholarship (Shanghai International Student Pre-college)
shanghai-normal-university.coverage: Tier A: tuition, housing, 2,500 RMB a month, insurance; tier B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-normal-university.description: For a one-year pre-college program (Chinese, maths and CSCA preparation) run by the university for the Shanghai Education Commission, preparing students for undergraduate study at Shanghai universities.
shanghai-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, 17 or over, scholarship applicants under 23 on 1 September 2026, healthy, with a strong high-school record and HSK 3 or above; no other Chinese government scholarship.
shanghai-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site with the 520 RMB fee, medical form, certificates, transcripts, statement, CV and recommendations.

guangxi-university.name: China Southern Power Grid Company Scholarship (Guangxi University, 2026)
guangxi-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, living costs and insurance, including a Chinese prep year for bachelor's
guangxi-university.description: Co-funded by China Southern Power Grid and the university to train bachelor's students in Electrical Engineering and Automation; master's students study Electrical Engineering, Law or Economics. Teaching is in Chinese, and bachelor's students first take a one-year Chinese course and must pass HSK 4 and the CSCA.
guangxi-university.eligibility: Passport holders from ASEAN countries or students sponsored by the company's overseas projects, healthy with no criminal record. Bachelor's: born after 1 September 1996; master's: bachelor's degree, born after 1 September 1991, HSK 4 (180+).
guangxi-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the online system and choose the scholarship; upload the standard documents plus two recommendations and a study plan for master's applicants; the university and company review and interview. The 2026 deadline was 21 June.

hunan-university.name: Partial Scholarship of Hunan University
hunan-university.coverage: Waives application fee, insurance, tuition and on-campus housing fees
hunan-university.description: A university partial scholarship for degree students (bachelor's 4 years, master's 2.5 years). English-taught majors are Business Administration, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Computer Science; Chinese-taught programs cover all 23 colleges. From an archived 2023 page, so terms may have changed.
hunan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; bachelor's aged 18 to 30, master's 18 to 35. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught majors; an English certificate or the university's English test for English-taught ones.
hunan-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system and upload the diploma, transcripts, passport copy, medical form and police certificate; master's applicants add a study plan and two professor recommendations.

sun-yat-sen-university.name: SYSU Scholarship for International Students (2026)
sun-yat-sen-university.coverage: Tier 1: full tuition plus 30,000 to 42,000 RMB a year stipend; tier 2: tuition; tier 3: half tuition
sun-yat-sen-university.description: A merit award for new students in all 2026 catalogue programs except MPA and MBA. Stipends are 30,000 RMB a year for bachelor's, 36,000 for master's and 42,000 for doctoral students, for the standard program length with an annual review. Recipients pay for housing, utilities, insurance, visa, flights and medical checks. The 2026 window has closed and the 2027 cycle is not yet posted.
sun-yat-sen-university.eligibility: Meet the 2026 enrolment rules with outstanding grades; bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; a recommendation from a recognised agency or ambassador in the home country. Holders of CSC, CLEC or MPA scholarships are excluded.
sun-yat-sen-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student application system and fill in the scholarship section; qualification review and interview follow, with results about 15 days after the interview.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan University International Student Scholarship (2026)
yunnan-university.coverage: Full: tuition and on-campus housing; partial: housing plus most of the tuition (5,000 RMB payable)
yunnan-university.description: A scholarship for full-time bachelor's, master's and doctoral students.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holders of good conduct and health; age 18 to 30 (bachelor's), 20 to 40 (master's), 22 to 45 (doctoral); HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the standard documents, a study plan and recommendations; experts review and may test or interview. The 2026 deadline was 30 June.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan University South and Southeast Asian University Alliance Ambassador Scholarship (2026)
yunnan-university.coverage: Full: tuition and housing; partial: housing plus most of the tuition (5,000 RMB payable)
yunnan-university.description: For students recommended by ambassadors at member universities of the alliance, covering non-degree Chinese language, master's and doctoral study, with the same tiers as the university scholarship.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holders recommended by an alliance-member ambassador; master's 20 to 40, doctoral 22 to 45.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the same documents as the university scholarship.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (via Yunnan University)
yunnan-university.coverage: Coverage not stated in the brochure; aimed mainly at South and Southeast Asian applicants
yunnan-university.description: A provincial scholarship administered by the university for degree students and Chinese-language non-degree students, mainly for South and Southeast Asian countries though others are welcome.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, of good conduct; bachelor's normally under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40, non-degree under 55; a CSCA report for bachelor's; HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the provincial scholarship form and standard documents; the university reviews and may interview.

liaoning-normal-university.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (Liaoning Normal University)
liaoning-normal-university.coverage: Doctoral only: tuition and housing waived, 3,500 RMB a month, insurance
liaoning-normal-university.description: A provincial scholarship for new doctoral students; students pay their own international travel.
liaoning-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, studying abroad, with a master's degree and under 40.
liaoning-normal-university.how_to_apply: Submit the forms and notarised diploma, transcripts, study plan and recommendations to the international college between December and the end of February each year.

dalian-university-of-technology.name: DUT International Students Presidential Scholarship (2026-27 intake)
dalian-university-of-technology.coverage: Full (graduate): tuition, housing and 1,500 or 1,800 RMB a month; partial: tuition, with or without housing
dalian-university-of-technology.description: A university-funded scholarship for new bachelor's, master's and doctoral students. Full awards (graduate only) cover tuition, on-campus housing and a monthly allowance; partial awards waive tuition, or tuition and housing. Travel and settlement costs are not covered; annual review applies; holders of CSC, Liaoning Government or ICLTS scholarships are excluded.
dalian-university-of-technology.eligibility: Bachelor's: finished high school with excellent results, under 25. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. Applicants outside China submit two recommendation letters from professors.
dalian-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Complete the online application and the Presidential Scholarship form, and upload the notarised diploma, transcripts, language proof and study plan. The window for master's and doctoral applicants is 1 November 2026 to 15 February 2027; bachelor's applicants have until 30 May 2027.

dalian-university-of-technology.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (Dalian University of Technology)
dalian-university-of-technology.coverage: Doctoral only: tuition and housing waived, 3,500 RMB a month, insurance; three years
dalian-university-of-technology.description: A provincial scholarship for new doctoral students, funded for three years; afterwards it may convert to the Presidential Scholarship, subject to review.
dalian-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a recognised master's degree, 40 or under, an excellent record, two professor recommendations and no other Chinese government scholarship.
dalian-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Apply on the online application system with the provincial form, notarised diploma, transcripts, a study plan of at least 1,000 words signed by a supervisor, two recommendations and the medical form; window 1 November 2026 to 15 February 2027.

tiangong-university.name: Tianjin Municipal Government Scholarship (Tiangong University)
tiangong-university.coverage: Partial: tuition for the first year of bachelor's or three years of master's
tiangong-university.description: A municipal scholarship supporting new international degree students on Chinese-taught or English-taught programs. The university screens documents and holds a video interview; each recipient gets no more than one Chinese government or university scholarship. From an older page, so terms may have changed.
tiangong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health who choose the university first, or current students; age 18 to 30 (bachelor's), up to 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral).
tiangong-university.how_to_apply: Fill in and sign the form and apply on the online system with the passport, notarised diploma, transcripts, two professor recommendations for postgraduates, medical form and language proof; admitted students pay a 500 RMB registration fee.

northeast-agricultural-university.name: MOE-Heilongjiang Eurasian Countries Scholarship (via NEAU)
northeast-agricultural-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and a stipend of 3,000 (master's) or 3,500 (doctoral) RMB a month
northeast-agricultural-university.description: A joint Ministry of Education and Heilongjiang program for students from 13 Eurasian countries, running 2026 to 2029 with 600 places; the university is a participating host.
northeast-agricultural-university.eligibility: Citizen of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Moldova, Azerbaijan or Mongolia. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs or TOEFL 95+ / IELTS 6.5+ for English-taught ones.
northeast-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Register in both the CSC online system and the university's own admission system and upload identical materials: notarised degree and transcripts, a study plan of at least 1,000 words, two professor recommendations, a medical form and a police certificate. The 2026 window was 1 November 2025 to 15 March 2026.

jiangsu-normal-university.name: JSNU Outstanding International Degree Students Scholarship
jiangsu-normal-university.coverage: First class: one year of tuition; second class: half a year of tuition
jiangsu-normal-university.description: A merit award for newly admitted degree students at two levels; the number of awards depends on the applicant pool. The level is set from the transcript (or the CSCA result for undergraduates) plus an interview.
jiangsu-normal-university.eligibility: Applicants to the university's international undergraduate or postgraduate degree programs; no separate criteria are listed.
jiangsu-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply for the degree program on the online system; there is no separate scholarship form. The 2026 postgraduate window was 5 March to 24 June.

guizhou-normal-university.name: Guizhou Province Foreign Student Scholarship (via GZNU)
guizhou-normal-university.coverage: Provincial-standard tuition, free dorm, monthly stipend and medical insurance
guizhou-normal-university.description: A provincial scholarship for degree students, with benefits matching the Chinese Government Scholarship.
guizhou-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no criminal record. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under.
guizhou-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register and submit on the university's international student platform; dates are in notices on its website.

guizhou-normal-university.name: Guizhou Normal University Scholarship (Chinese advanced student program)
guizhou-normal-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing and insurance; half: 50% tuition, housing and insurance
guizhou-normal-university.description: A university-funded full or half award for students on the mainly Chinese-taught advanced student program; 2026 admission notices were expected in July and August.
guizhou-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no criminal record, with a high-school diploma or higher, aged 18 to 40.
guizhou-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the same online platform; dates are in notices on the university's website.

shanghai-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (Shanghai University)
shanghai-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, stipend and insurance; partial: tuition and insurance
shanghai-university.description: A Shanghai municipal scholarship for new international students. Full awards add a housing allowance (700 RMB a month for bachelor's and master's, 1,000 for doctoral) and a stipend (2,500 / 3,000 / 3,500 RMB). Partial awards pay tuition and insurance only.
shanghai-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Bachelor's: high-school graduate under 25. Master's: bachelor's degree under 35. Doctoral: master's degree under 40.
shanghai-university.how_to_apply: Apply online with the documents and the scholarship form; after pre-admission choose the funding method, enter the scholarship code and pay the 500 RMB fee. The 2026 window ran 20 November 2025 to 30 April 2026.

shanghai-university.name: Shanghai University New International Student Scholarship
shanghai-university.coverage: Partial: tuition covered; discounted dorm (700 RMB master's, 1,000 RMB doctoral a month)
shanghai-university.description: The university's own partial award for new master's and doctoral students, with no separate stipend or insurance.
shanghai-university.eligibility: Master's and doctoral applicants only, in good health: bachelor's degree under 35 or master's degree under 40.
shanghai-university.how_to_apply: No separate application; recipients are chosen from applicants to the national university program and the Shanghai Government Scholarship.

southwest-jiaotong-university.name: SWJTU Presidential Scholarship
southwest-jiaotong-university.coverage: Tuition, insurance and free housing; master's 1,500 and doctoral 2,000 RMB a month
southwest-jiaotong-university.description: A full scholarship for outstanding master's (3 years) and doctoral (4 years) students, with a 500 RMB housing allowance if off-campus housing is approved. Stipend figures come from the 2024 notice; the 2025 page leaves them unspecified.
southwest-jiaotong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Master's: bachelor's degree, excellent grades, generally under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, generally under 40. HSK 5 for Chinese-taught programs. No other scholarship; two professor recommendations.
southwest-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and choose Presidential Scholarship; after preliminary review pay the 400 RMB fee within three days. There may be an interview, with results in July. The 2025 round closed on 10 June.

southwest-jiaotong-university.name: Chengdu Government Scholarship (via SWJTU)
southwest-jiaotong-university.coverage: Yearly: bachelor's 20,000 RMB; master's 3,000; doctoral 3,500; non-degree 1,000 a month
southwest-jiaotong-university.description: A Chengdu municipal award supporting living and study costs for students from Chengdu's sister cities.
southwest-jiaotong-university.eligibility: Full-time bachelor's, master's, doctoral or non-degree students from sister cities. Students holding another Sichuan scholarship for international students cannot apply.
southwest-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: The page points to a separate sister-city scholarship notice; no steps are given.

fuzhou-university.name: Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship (Fuzhou University)
fuzhou-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance plus a monthly allowance, for one year
fuzhou-university.description: A merit award chosen from admitted students and renewable after annual review. Tuition is 14,000 RMB a year, housing 3,500 and insurance 800; recipients still pay about 2,000 RMB for the residence permit and medical exam.
fuzhou-university.eligibility: Selected on merit from admitted students; HSK 4 or above, or passing all CSCA levels, gets priority.
fuzhou-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the normal admission application; the provincial form is downloadable and hard-copy materials must be posted. The 2026 deadline was 30 May.

fuzhou-university.name: Fuzhou University Scholarship for International Students
fuzhou-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance plus a monthly allowance, for one year
fuzhou-university.description: A university-funded award with the same benefits as the provincial one; applicants can be considered for both at once.
fuzhou-university.eligibility: Selected on merit from admitted students; HSK 4 or above, or passing all CSCA levels, gets priority.
fuzhou-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the normal admission application with no extra scholarship materials.

huazhong-agricultural-university.name: Huazhong Agricultural University Scholarship
huazhong-agricultural-university.coverage: Tuition waiver, free housing, insurance and a stipend of 2,100 or 2,500 RMB a month
huazhong-agricultural-university.description: A university scholarship for master's and doctoral students. Terms come from the 2023 intake notice; the graduate school's page says full and partial types exist without amounts, and a 2025 notice says it goes to applicants who did not win the national scholarship.
huazhong-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 40. Doctoral: master's degree, under 45.
huazhong-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Apply online through the university's application website and upload scanned documents; the 2023 window ran 1 November 2022 to 31 March 2023.

guangxi-minzu-university.name: Guangxi Minzu University International Student Scholarship
guangxi-minzu-university.coverage: Tuition only: 12,000, 15,000 or 18,000 RMB a year by field
guangxi-minzu-university.description: An undergraduate award paying registration and tuition but not housing, living costs or insurance. Terms come from the 2024 page.
guangxi-minzu-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, a high-school graduate under 25 with strong grades; HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs or IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 70 for English-taught ones.
guangxi-minzu-university.how_to_apply: Email the scanned documents (form, passport, diploma, transcripts, language certificate, study plan, medical form, police certificate) to the admissions office; an exam or video interview may follow.

guangxi-minzu-university.name: Guangxi Government ASEAN Countries Students Scholarship (via GXMZU)
guangxi-minzu-university.coverage: Free tuition, dorm and insurance; stipend 1,000, 1,500 or 2,000 RMB a month
guangxi-minzu-university.description: A Guangxi government scholarship for new students from ASEAN countries, as described on the 2024 page.
guangxi-minzu-university.eligibility: ASEAN citizens new to China. Undergraduate under 25; master's: bachelor's degree under 35; doctoral: master's degree under 40. Not for programs in the applicant's own language.
guangxi-minzu-university.how_to_apply: Email the scanned documents, plus two recommendations for postgraduates, to the admissions office.

beijing-forestry-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Beijing Forestry University)
beijing-forestry-university.coverage: Full or partial tuition waiver for one academic year; reapply each year
beijing-forestry-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship the university receives, reviews and approves. It covers tuition only and cannot be combined with other scholarships.
beijing-forestry-university.eligibility: Admitted or enrolled international students (degree, visiting or language programs; language students need over six months at the university). Good grades, health and conduct, with recommendations and a study plan of 800, 1,000 or 2,000 words by level.
beijing-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Complete the degree application first, then submit the scholarship form, diploma, transcripts, language proof, recommendations and study plan to the international office; the Chinese page names 30 December (spring) and 30 June (autumn).

beijing-forestry-university.name: Experience Beilin Scholarship
beijing-forestry-university.coverage: Full or partial tuition for one year, Master of Landscape Architecture; renewed annually
beijing-forestry-university.description: Funds tuition for outstanding candidates in the Landscape Architecture master's program for one year; it must be applied for every year.
beijing-forestry-university.eligibility: Candidates for the Master of Landscape Architecture; the detailed requirements page is not accessible.
beijing-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Apply after completing the degree application; the university selects from pre-admitted students.

southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.name: SWUFE Belt and Road International Student Scholarship
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.coverage: Full (tuition, housing, living allowance) or tuition only, for bachelor's and master's
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.description: A university scholarship for degree applicants; recipients undergo an annual review.
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with strong grades; bachelor's aged 18 to 30, master's 18 to 35. HSK 5 (60+ per section) for Chinese-taught programs; IELTS 6.0 (bachelor's) or 6.5 (master's) for English-taught ones. Bachelor's applicants need CSCA results. No national government scholarship.
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student system with the notarised diploma, transcripts, study plan, recommendations, passport, medical form, police certificate and financial guarantee; the fee is 600 RMB. The 2026 window was 1 January to 30 April.

southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.name: SWUFE Comprehensive Evaluation Scholarship (enrolled students)
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.coverage: Cash awards of 300 to 2,000 RMB per semester
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.description: Semester awards for enrolled international students: first prize 2,000, second 1,000, third 500, with two special 300 RMB awards for academic results and conduct.
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.eligibility: Students who studied at least one semester and will continue for at least one more, with 90% attendance and compliance with Chinese law and school rules.
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e.how_to_apply: Apply each semester in the last four weeks of term by submitting the form to the international college's student affairs office; results are posted for seven days.

jiangnan-university.name: Jiangnan University Chancellor's and Taihu Scholarships
jiangnan-university.coverage: Annual merit awards for enrolled international students (amounts not stated)
jiangnan-university.description: Awards given each academic year: the Chancellor's Scholarship rewards good students who already have a tuition waiver and the Taihu Scholarship rewards good self-funded students, with single-item awards for research, Chinese, sports and volunteering.
jiangnan-university.eligibility: Enrolled international students with good academic results.
jiangnan-university.how_to_apply: The page does not describe the process; contact the admissions office.

jiangnan-university.name: Study in Jiangsu Government Scholarship (outstanding students, via Jiangnan University)
jiangnan-university.coverage: Annual award for outstanding enrolled students (amount not stated)
jiangnan-university.description: A Jiangsu provincial award, selected once a year, recognising students with strong academic and overall performance at graduate and undergraduate levels.
jiangnan-university.eligibility: Enrolled international students with excellent grades and overall performance.
jiangnan-university.how_to_apply: The page gives no procedure; contact the admissions office.

jiangxi-normal-university.name: Jiangxi Provincial Government Scholarship (Jiangxi Normal University)
jiangxi-normal-university.coverage: Cash award per year: 25,000 RMB (master's, doctoral) or 20,000 RMB (bachelor's)
jiangxi-normal-university.description: A provincial cash award for new self-funded students, applied for after enrolment and only after fees are paid in full.
jiangxi-normal-university.eligibility: Newly enrolled self-funded doctoral, master's or bachelor's students.
jiangxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply after enrolment, starting in October each year, using the provincial scholarship form on the international students site.

jiangxi-normal-university.name: Jiangxi Normal University Scholarship for International Students
jiangxi-normal-university.coverage: 15,000 RMB per year for doctoral, master's, bachelor's and language students
jiangxi-normal-university.description: A university cash award at one rate for all levels including language students.
jiangxi-normal-university.eligibility: Enrolled international students; further criteria are not stated in the readable part of the source.
jiangxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Use the scholarship application form on the scholarship page and submit it to the international programs office.

south-china-university-of-technology.name: SCUT International Student Scholarship for Excellence
south-china-university-of-technology.coverage: Full or half tuition waiver; doctoral also gets 1,400 RMB a month
south-china-university-of-technology.description: A merit scholarship. Bachelor's and master's recipients get first class (full tuition waiver), second class (half) or third class (half for two years). The doctoral full scholarship covers tuition plus 1,400 RMB a month. Reviewed each May.
south-china-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health entering full-time degree programs.
south-china-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: No separate application; candidates are chosen from self-funded admission applicants on merit. The page lists a 15 June deadline.

south-china-university-of-technology.name: Guangdong Provincial Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship (SCUT)
south-china-university-of-technology.description: A Guangdong government scholarship for full-time students with outstanding academic results; the final list follows the province's announcement.
south-china-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy. Bachelor's applicants 25 or under, master's under 35, doctoral under 40.
south-china-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: No separate application; candidates are chosen from self-funded admission applicants. The page lists a 15 June deadline.

anhui-agricultural-university.name: Anhui Provincial Government and University Scholarships (partial)
anhui-agricultural-university.coverage: One-time cash: 20,000 (bachelor's), 30,000 (master's) or 50,000 (doctoral) RMB a year
anhui-agricultural-university.description: Non-full scholarships for full-time degree students; they are a cash contribution only, and recipients still pay tuition, housing, living and insurance costs, with the cash paid after all fees are paid on arrival.
anhui-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, with a high-school diploma (bachelor's), bachelor's degree (master's) or master's degree (doctoral).
anhui-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Apply to the university through the international education college's application guide and online application.

northwest-af-university.name: Northwest A&F University International Student Scholarship
northwest-af-university.coverage: Full (tuition, housing, insurance, stipend), first-class partial or 50% tuition waiver
northwest-af-university.description: For bachelor's, master's and doctoral students, prioritising agriculture, life sciences, resources and environment, food, engineering and economics; reviewed annually.
northwest-af-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no other scholarship. Doctoral under 35, master's under 30, bachelor's under 25; HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs; bachelor's applicants need the CSCA.
northwest-af-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's international student application system; steps are college review, academic evaluation, then admissions committee approval. The page lists a 31 May deadline.

northwest-af-university.name: APFNet Scholarship for Master's Programs (Northwest A&F University)
northwest-af-university.coverage: Full tuition waiver, dorm, airfare and medical fee; two-year English master's
northwest-af-university.description: A fully funded two-year master's program with the Asia-Pacific Network for Sustainable Forest Management and Rehabilitation, for forestry and environment fields.
northwest-af-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese from Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan or Kyrgyzstan, aged 18 to 40 with a bachelor's degree, IELTS or TOEFL, a supervisor's acceptance and a network council recommendation; women are encouraged to apply.
northwest-af-university.how_to_apply: Get a supervisor's acceptance letter, then apply on the university's system choosing the APFNet master's scholarship with one combined PDF of notarised documents.

northwest-af-university.name: Xi'an Five Central Asian Countries Scholarship (Northwest A&F University)
northwest-af-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, living allowance, insurance and residence permit fees
northwest-af-university.description: For citizens of five Central Asian countries, lasting the standard program length (4 years doctoral, 3 master's, 4 to 5 bachelor's) with an annual review.
northwest-af-university.eligibility: Nationals of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan or Uzbekistan. Doctoral under 40, master's under 35, bachelor's under 24; HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs; undergraduates start with a preparatory year and need the CSCA.
northwest-af-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student system with the program form, notarised documents, a study plan, a supervisor's letter for graduates, medical form and police clearance.

university-of-science-and-technology-bei.name: USTB Chancellor Dingxin Scholarship
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.coverage: Full (tuition, housing, living costs, insurance) or partial; bachelor's 4 years, master's 2 to 3, doctoral 4
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.description: A scholarship for 2027 entrants to bachelor's, master's and doctoral programs; partial awards cover one or more items of the full package. Reviewed annually.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, 30 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 40 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 45 or under.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.how_to_apply: Register on the online application site, choose the Dingxin Scholarship, upload materials and pay the fee; results come at the end of June 2027.

university-of-science-and-technology-bei.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (USTB, 2027)
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.coverage: Beijing scholarship in three tiers (A, B, C) with tuition and housing support
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship offered through the university for new degree and preparatory students and for self-funded current students.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.eligibility: Friendly, healthy non-Chinese applicants with no other scholarship. Age limits 24 (preparatory), 25 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral). Tier A normally needs a top-500 world university or key high school (grade 85 or GPA 3.6); tiers B and C need a key school (grade 80 or GPA 3.0).
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.how_to_apply: New students tick the Beijing scholarship box in the admission system; current students submit the form to their class advisor in April 2027.

university-of-science-and-technology-bei.name: USTB Outstanding International Students Scholarship (enrolled students)
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.description: Cash awards for outstanding enrolled international students: first prize 5,000, second 3,000, third 1,000.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.eligibility: Students with more than one academic year at the university, 90% attendance, good grades and conduct and active participation in group activities.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei.how_to_apply: Submit the application form to the international student center, usually in October.

jilin-agricultural-university.name: Jilin Agricultural University International Student Scholarship
jilin-agricultural-university.coverage: Full scholarship: tuition waiver plus 1,000 RMB a month for three to four years
jilin-agricultural-university.description: A university full scholarship for outstanding international students, waiving tuition and paying a monthly stipend for three to four years.
jilin-agricultural-university.eligibility: Students with good academic and conduct records; HSK results (otherwise one to two years of Chinese study), two recommendations from associate professors or above and a study plan of at least 800 words.
jilin-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Request or download the scholarship form and mail it with the admission form and other documents to the international education and exchange college.

jilin-agricultural-university.name: Jilin Provincial Government (Changbai Mountain) Scholarship (via JLAU)
jilin-agricultural-university.coverage: Full master's award: tuition, housing, insurance and 1,700 RMB a month for two years
jilin-agricultural-university.description: A provincial full scholarship for full-time master's students at Jilin universities; foreign-language and literature majors in students' own languages are excluded. The stipend figure may be out of date.
jilin-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international education and exchange college; applications are accepted before 30 July each year.

donghua-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (Donghua University)
donghua-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, insurance, dorm and 2,500 to 3,500 RMB a month; class B: tuition and insurance
donghua-university.description: A Shanghai city award administered through the university for Chinese-taught bachelor's, master's and doctoral study; class A is full and class B partial, running the whole program.
donghua-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a strong record and no other Chinese government or institutional scholarship. Bachelor's: high-school graduate, 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under.
donghua-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the admissions system and pick the Shanghai or national category as the funding source; there is no separate application on the Shanghai scholarship site.

donghua-university.name: DHU Excellent International Student Scholarship (enrolled degree students)
donghua-university.coverage: Next-term tuition waiver of 6,000, 4,000 or 2,000 RMB; Niuxilan award 10,000 RMB
donghua-university.description: Comprehensive awards in three grades, assessed each October and capped at 1%, 2% and 5% of degree students, plus a corporate-funded Niuxilan award (5 places) and single-item cash awards for social work, sports, arts, competitions and publications.
donghua-university.eligibility: Enrolled full-time degree students with good conduct, no failed courses and no disciplinary record; GPA of at least 3.5, 3.0 or 2.5 by grade; graduating classes are excluded from all but the single-item awards.
donghua-university.how_to_apply: Apply each October on the international college's system with the application form, transcript and certificates.

zhejiang-sci-tech-university.name: Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship (via ZSTU)
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.description: A provincial scholarship paid in three tiers: A for graduate degree students, B for bachelor's and C for long-term non-degree students. Read from archived 2025 copies of older pages, so terms may have changed.
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no other Chinese scholarship. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, 30 or under. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs and two professor recommendations for graduates.
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the university's online system with the form, passport, diploma, transcripts, medical exam, recommendations and language certificate; windows were 1 to 30 April (A) and 1 to 31 May (B).

zhejiang-sci-tech-university.name: ZSTU Freshmen Scholarship
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.coverage: One academic year's tuition waived; 50% for long-term non-degree
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.description: A tuition waiver for new master's, doctoral, bachelor's and long-term non-degree students; the number of awards depends on the yearly budget. From an archived page, so terms may have changed.
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no other scholarship and no bad record, with a strong record at the relevant level; HSK 5, TOEFL 78+ or IELTS 6+ and a supervisor's acceptance preferred.
zhejiang-sci-tech-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the online system and upload the passport, diploma, transcripts, medical report, references and language certificate; windows were 1 to 30 April (graduate) and 1 to 30 May (bachelor's).

changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.name: Jilin Provincial Government Scholarship, CUST program
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.coverage: Full: tuition, free dorm, 1,700 RMB a month and insurance; six places
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.description: A full provincial scholarship for English-taught master's study in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Application Technology, Information and Communication Engineering and MBA, lasting two years. Based on the 2025 guide.
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, with a bachelor's degree, under 35, and a GPA over 3.4/4 (or an average of 80+).
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.how_to_apply: Register on the application site and choose the Jilin Provincial Government Scholarship option; the university reviews and interviews top candidates.

changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.name: CUST Scholarship for English-taught Master's (partial)
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.description: A partial scholarship for English-taught master's programs (Computer Application Technology, Mechanical Engineering, MBA, Information and Communication Engineering), ten places per major on a first-come basis; year two needs attendance above 85% and no failed courses.
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, with a bachelor's degree, under 35, average 70% or GPA 2.8/4, IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 80 unless exempt, and no other Chinese scholarship.
changchun-university-of-science-and-tech.how_to_apply: Apply online and choose the scholarship on the program pages, uploading the standard documents.

northeastern-university.name: Liaoning Province Government Scholarship (doctoral, NEU)
northeastern-university.coverage: Free tuition and dorm, 3,500 RMB a month and insurance for three years
northeastern-university.description: A provincial scholarship for doctoral study; no extra Chinese-language year is available. From the 2026 doctoral application guide, which says it does not apply to master's applicants.
northeastern-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, over 20 and under 40, with a master's degree; HSK 5 (180) for Chinese-taught majors or English proof for English-taught ones; a supervisor's acceptance letter.
northeastern-university.how_to_apply: Get the supervisor's signed acceptance form, then apply on the university's application site and choose the Liaoning scholarship as funding; applying for the national scheme too needs a separate application.

central-china-normal-university.name: CCNU Scholarship for Excellent New Students
central-china-normal-university.coverage: Tuition waiver only: full, half or partial (2,000 to 8,000 RMB)
central-china-normal-university.description: A merit tuition waiver for new degree students that does not cover housing or living costs. This is the 2022 notice, so tiers and quotas may have changed.
central-china-normal-university.eligibility: New bachelor's, master's or doctoral students starting in September. Bachelor's: high school, 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 45 or under. No other university scholarship.
central-china-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the application site, open the scholarship application, upload documents and submit online; results come by email in early to mid July.

dalian-maritime-university.name: DMU Scholarships for Excellent International Students
dalian-maritime-university.coverage: Tuition discounts: new students 2,000, undergraduates up to 8,000, master's up to 10,000, graduates up to 40,000 RMB
dalian-maritime-university.description: Awards for self-funded students in six categories: excellent new students, language students, undergraduates, master's, good progress and excellent graduates. Winners get a discount on the next payment.
dalian-maritime-university.eligibility: Follow Chinese law and university rules with good grades, attendance and conduct, and have joined at least one university-level activity or contest.
dalian-maritime-university.how_to_apply: Applications and selection run in May (spring) and November (autumn); contact the academic affairs office.

ningxia-university.name: Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Government Scholarship (Ningxia University)
ningxia-university.coverage: Monthly stipend 1,000, 1,500 or 2,000 RMB plus academic and HSK awards; tuition and housing paid by the student
ningxia-university.description: A regional scheme for self-funded bachelor's, master's, doctoral and language students, 10 to 15 places a year. It pays a ten-month stipend and yearly academic awards (15,000 / 10,000 / 5,000 RMB), HSK awards (500 to 700) and honour awards (500 to 1,000). From a 2022 page.
ningxia-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no other scholarship. Bachelor's: high school, 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under. Language students 18 to 60.
ningxia-university.how_to_apply: Register and apply on the application site, upload notarised documents, a plan, recommendations and health and police certificates; results are published in early July.

guizhou-university.name: Guizhou University Scholarship for International Students (2026)
guizhou-university.coverage: Free tuition and free on-campus accommodation for the normal study period
guizhou-university.description: A university scholarship for bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees; English-taught bachelor's majors are Computer Science, Chemical Biology and Veterinary Medicine. It does not cover insurance, registration, medical exam or visa fees, and an annual review decides continuation.
guizhou-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy. Bachelor's: high school, under 25. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs; English-taught programs need an English score plus the university's English test.
guizhou-university.how_to_apply: Bachelor's applicants take the CSCA first; apply on the online platform and upload documents; results come by system message and email.

harbin-institute-of-technology.name: HIT International Students Scholarship
harbin-institute-of-technology.coverage: Tuition waiver at four tiers: 100%, 50%, 30% or 20%
harbin-institute-of-technology.description: A merit award for self-funded international degree students; the tier sets the share of tuition waived and recipients are reviewed every year.
harbin-institute-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Bachelor's under 25, master's under 30, doctoral under 35. HSK 4 (210+) for Chinese-taught programs or an English test for English-taught ones. No other scholarship.
harbin-institute-of-technology.how_to_apply: Fill in the online form, pay the 600 RMB fee by bank transfer and email the documents (passport page, transcripts, language certificate, study plan, two recommendations for graduates, medical record, police certificate, bank deposit proof).

beijing-normal-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Beijing Normal University)
beijing-normal-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, stipend, insurance; B: no stipend; C: tuition and insurance
beijing-normal-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship awarded to newly admitted international students for no longer than the program's standard length; recipients take an annual review.
beijing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, friendly to China and in good health, admitted that year. Age limits: bachelor's 25, master's 35, doctoral 40, non-degree 45. No other government or organisation scholarship.
beijing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the online application system and select this scholarship; mail the paper materials as instructed.

beijing-normal-university.name: BNU New International Student Scholarship
beijing-normal-university.coverage: Tuition waived, living allowance and comprehensive insurance for the full standard program
beijing-normal-university.description: The university's own award for strong new degree students; it ends if the student extends, suspends or withdraws, and a May review decides whether it continues (one failure suspends it for a year, a second cancels it).
beijing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, admitted to a degree program starting that year, with good results and no other scholarship.
beijing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and print the form on the international site, then submit the materials listed in the admissions brochure.

beijing-normal-university.name: BNU Silk Road Muduo Scholarship
beijing-normal-university.coverage: Tuition waived, living allowance and insurance for the full standard program
beijing-normal-university.description: For degree students from Belt and Road countries, with the same coverage and May review rules as the new-student scholarship.
beijing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health from a Belt and Road country, admitted to a degree program starting that year with strong results and no other funding.
beijing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and print the form on the international site, then submit the materials listed in the brochure.

capital-normal-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Capital Normal University, 2026 guide)
capital-normal-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, stipend, insurance; B: no stipend; C: tuition and insurance
capital-normal-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship administered for new and current international students in degree and non-degree programs. Class A needs a stronger background such as a QS top-500 university; a yearly review can suspend or cancel it. The 2026 deadline has passed.
capital-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, friendly to China and in good health. Age limits: bachelor's 25, master's 35, doctoral 40, non-degree 45. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught degrees. Class A: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85 and an average of 85 or GPA 3.6; B and C: average 80 or GPA 3.0.
capital-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the online system; graduate and visiting applicants add two recommendations.

chongqing-university.name: Chongqing University President Scholarship
chongqing-university.coverage: First class: tuition, housing, insurance and 1,500 to 2,200 RMB a month; second: tuition; third: half tuition
chongqing-university.description: The university's own award for outstanding degree students (bachelor's, master's, doctoral). First class also covers housing, or a 700 RMB monthly subsidy if housing is short; stipends are 2,200 (doctoral), 1,800 (master's) or 1,500 (bachelor's) RMB a month. From the December 2023 guide, read from an archived copy.
chongqing-university.eligibility: Admitted to an eligible degree program; the page refers to the application guide for further criteria.
chongqing-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international student admission portal; interview dates and results come by email.

chongqing-university.name: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship (Chongqing University)
chongqing-university.coverage: Cash award of 30,000 (master's) or 35,000 RMB (doctoral) a year, paid monthly
chongqing-university.description: A Chongqing city scholarship for master's and doctoral students, paid as living costs; recipients still pay tuition, housing and insurance. It lasts the program's length with a yearly review. From the December 2023 guide.
chongqing-university.eligibility: Master's and doctoral applicants only; the page refers to the postgraduate application guide.
chongqing-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the international student admission portal under the postgraduate guide; interviews and results come by email.

northeast-normal-university.name: NENU Presidential Scholarship for Outstanding International Students
northeast-normal-university.coverage: Full scholarship for outstanding newly admitted self-funded students
northeast-normal-university.description: The university's own full scholarship; each year newly admitted self-funded students are assessed on results, language level, overall ability and potential and the best are chosen.
northeast-normal-university.how_to_apply: Not described on the page; contact the international students office.

northeast-normal-university.name: NENU Scholarships for Outstanding Self-Financed International Students
northeast-normal-university.coverage: Merit awards for current self-funded degree and non-degree students; amounts not on the page
northeast-normal-university.description: Awarded yearly to degree students and each semester to non-degree students, who can apply repeatedly but not on the basis of the final year or an extension.
northeast-normal-university.eligibility: Self-funded students with fees paid and a clean record. Degree students: year two or later, 90% attendance, top 5% of their major, no failed courses. Non-degree students: at least one semester, 90% attendance and 12 credits. Scholarship holders and tuition-free exchange students are excluded.
northeast-normal-university.how_to_apply: Download the form, get it approved by the school and dormitory office and hand it in to the international students office with transcripts and evidence.

ocean-university-of-china.name: OUC International Student President Scholarship
ocean-university-of-china.coverage: Class 1: tuition, housing, insurance and stipend; class 2: tuition and housing; class 3: tuition
ocean-university-of-china.description: The university's own award for newly enrolled self-funded students at bachelor's, master's and doctoral level. Class 1 is for master's and doctoral applicants only and includes a ten-month stipend; all classes include medical insurance. It lasts the standard program length with a yearly review.
ocean-university-of-china.eligibility: Newly enrolled self-funded international degree students; detailed conditions are in the application guide.
ocean-university-of-china.how_to_apply: Register on the international student service system and submit materials online with the scholarship form and the 400 RMB fee; the window is 1 March to 25 May each year.

guangxi-normal-university.name: GXNU Scholarship for International Master's and Doctoral Students
guangxi-normal-university.coverage: Full tuition and dorm waiver plus a stipend: doctoral 3,500, master's 2,000 RMB a month
guangxi-normal-university.description: For new master's and doctoral students in listed programs (Marxism Theory, Chinese Language and Literature, Chemistry, Physics, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Sport Science), three years for master's and three to four for doctoral; costs beyond that are the student's.
guangxi-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holder in good health with no criminal record. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. HSK 5 (180+) or IELTS 6.0; two recommendations.
guangxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site and pay the 400 RMB fee; upload the form, passport, degrees, recommendations, language certificate, an 800-word study plan and medical form; eligible applicants are interviewed.

guangxi-normal-university.name: MOE-Guangxi Government Scholarship for ASEAN Students (2027-2028 admissions)
guangxi-normal-university.coverage: Scholarship for ASEAN-country students; coverage amounts are not shown on the brochure
guangxi-normal-university.description: Funded by the Ministry of Education and the Guangxi government and run by the university, covering bachelor's, master's and doctoral programs in education, software engineering, computer science, chemistry, environment, physics, math, AI and ecology; students live in university dormitories.
guangxi-normal-university.eligibility: Citizen of an ASEAN country. Age limits: bachelor's 25, master's 35, doctoral 40. HSK 4 (180+) for Chinese-taught programs; bachelor's applicants take the CSCA.
guangxi-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on both the university's application system and the national study-in-China system and upload the form, passport, transcripts, language proof, pre-admission notice, a 1,000-word study plan, degree proof, police certificate, two recommendations, medical form and fee receipt.

dongbei-university-of-finance-and-econom.name: DUFE Partial Scholarships (freshmen, foundation, alumni, outstanding students)
dongbei-university-of-finance-and-econom.coverage: Freshmen 3,500; foundation 5,000; alumni 10% tuition; outstanding students 3,000 to 6,000 RMB a year
dongbei-university-of-finance-and-econom.description: Four partial awards. The page looks dated, so amounts may have changed.
dongbei-university-of-finance-and-econom.eligibility: Freshmen award: English-medium bachelor's or master's applicants with IELTS 6.5. Foundation award: HSK 4 (220) after the foundation year. Alumni award: former students entering a degree program. Outstanding-student award: based on grades.
dongbei-university-of-finance-and-econom.how_to_apply: Apply through the online system; the window is January to mid-April each year.

inner-mongolia-university.name: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government Scholarship (graduate, 2026-27)
inner-mongolia-university.coverage: Tuition and fees waived, free dorm, regional living stipend and medical insurance
inner-mongolia-university.description: Regional funding for full-time master's (3 years) and doctoral (4 years) students, with an optional extra year of Chinese preparation. Recipients may not hold any other government or university scholarship. The application is free and the university uses no agents.
inner-mongolia-university.eligibility: Mongolian citizen in good health. Master's: bachelor's degree, generally 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, generally 40 or under. HSK 3 or above for Chinese-taught programs unless a previous degree was taught in Chinese.
inner-mongolia-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and upload the documents; the program list and checklist are attached to the notice. Expert review and an online interview follow. The 2026 window ran 1 to 25 June.

henan-university.name: Henan Province Outstanding International Students Scholarship
henan-university.coverage: Tuition and dorm; master's 1,500 and doctoral 2,000 RMB a month
henan-university.description: A provincial scholarship administered by the university for Chinese-language, bachelor's, master's and doctoral students, with an annual review each May. Terms are from the 2023 notice.
henan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no criminal record. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, under 30. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. HSK 4 (bachelor's) or HSK 5 (graduate), or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 86 for English programs.
henan-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's international student application system and upload the passport, diploma, transcripts, study plan, recommendations (graduate), health and police documents and language proof; admission letters go out in mid-July.

henan-university.name: Henan University International Student Scholarship (graduate)
henan-university.coverage: Tuition and double-room dorm; master's 3,000 and doctoral 3,500 RMB a month
henan-university.description: A university scholarship for master's (2 to 3 years) and doctoral (4 years) students, renewed through an annual review each May. Terms are from the 2022 notice.
henan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with no criminal record. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 86 for English programs; HSK 4 (master's) or HSK 5 (doctoral) plus HSKK intermediate for Chinese programs.
henan-university.how_to_apply: Apply in the online application system with the passport, degree, transcripts, a study plan (600+ words master's, 800+ doctoral), two professor recommendations, health forms and police certificate; results come around 10 July.

hohai-university.name: Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship (Hohai University)
hohai-university.coverage: Full tuition, free dorm, living allowance of 15,000 to 30,000 RMB a year, medical insurance
hohai-university.description: Jiangsu government funding for degree students: 15,000 RMB (bachelor's), 25,000 (master's) or 30,000 (doctoral) a year, plus 800 RMB insurance. Selection uses the academic record and may include an interview.
hohai-university.eligibility: Healthy non-Chinese. Bachelor's: high-school diploma, 18 to 30. Master's: bachelor's degree, generally under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, generally under 40. No other full scholarship.
hohai-university.how_to_apply: Get a funding certificate from the Jiangsu Department of Education, then apply on the admissions portal and upload it; applications generally open January to April.

hohai-university.name: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship (Hohai University)
hohai-university.coverage: Cash only: 10,000 RMB bachelor's, 20,000 master's, 5,000 visiting students a year
hohai-university.description: A Nanjing city subsidy administered through the university; it pays money only and does not cover tuition, living costs or housing.
hohai-university.eligibility: Foreign passport holder in good health at bachelor's, master's, doctoral or visiting level; no Chinese government or other full scholarship.
hohai-university.how_to_apply: The page refers applicants to the university's notice; applications are generally taken September to October.

hohai-university.name: Hohai University Scholarship (undergraduate, three tiers)
hohai-university.coverage: Tier 1: tuition, dorm, insurance, living costs; tier 2: tuition and dorm; tier 3: tuition
hohai-university.description: The university's own scholarship for new international bachelor's students, in three tiers by high-school results. HSK 5 is required for all tiers, with 240 or more for tier 1.
hohai-university.eligibility: Age 18 to 30, healthy, high-school diploma and a valid passport, HSK 5; tier 1 needs an average above 80 or top 20% rank.
hohai-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the admissions portal and pay the 400 RMB fee; applications generally open January to April.

nanning-normal-university.name: Guangxi Government ASEAN Full Scholarship (2026-27)
nanning-normal-university.coverage: Waived registration, tuition and dorm fees, monthly living allowance, medical insurance
nanning-normal-university.description: A Guangxi government full scholarship for ASEAN students on Chinese-language, bachelor's, master's and doctoral programs, with quotas mostly nominated by partner bodies. Visa, medical exam, travel and utilities are the student's own cost.
nanning-normal-university.eligibility: ASEAN citizen in good health with no other Chinese government scholarship. Language students 25 or under; bachelor's HSK 4 (180+) or a year of Chinese study, 25 or under; master's generally 35 or under; doctoral generally 40 or under.
nanning-normal-university.how_to_apply: Email the scanned documents to the admissions office and register in the university's online system; the 2026 cycle closed on 31 May.

beijing-language-and-culture-university.name: Beijing Foreign Student Scholarship (BLCU)
beijing-language-and-culture-university.coverage: First-year tuition only; all other costs are the student's
beijing-language-and-culture-university.description: Beijing government tuition support for self-funded new bachelor's, master's and doctoral students, decided by the university's review committee.
beijing-language-and-culture-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, friendly to China with no criminal record and strong academics. Age on 1 September 2026: bachelor's 30 or under, master's 35, doctoral 40.
beijing-language-and-culture-university.how_to_apply: Download the new-student form, apply on the application site and email the form to the admissions office; results come in February for the March 2027 intake.

beijing-language-and-culture-university.name: BLCU International Student Scholarship
beijing-language-and-culture-university.coverage: Awards for enrolled foreign students: study, research, attendance, friendship, contribution
beijing-language-and-culture-university.description: School-level awards for enrolled foreign students with excellent grades and conduct or notable contributions; amounts and procedure are not stated on the page.
beijing-language-and-culture-university.eligibility: Foreign students currently enrolled at the university.
beijing-language-and-culture-university.how_to_apply: The page gives no procedure; contact the international student admissions office.

changchun-university-of-chinese-medicine.name: CCUCM Belt and Road / President's Scholarship
changchun-university-of-chinese-medicine.coverage: Cash awards by tier: bachelor's 1,000 to 3,000, master's 2,000 to 5,000, doctoral 3,000 to 6,000 RMB a year
changchun-university-of-chinese-medicine.description: An annual merit award for self-funded degree students from Belt and Road countries, paid per semester in first, second and third prizes. Rules are from a 2022 publication; a college panel reviews, the list is posted for three days and the president approves.
changchun-university-of-chinese-medicine.eligibility: Citizen of a Belt and Road country, healthy, a high-school graduate or above, under 35, HSK 4 or above, with good conduct and studies.
changchun-university-of-chinese-medicine.how_to_apply: Within one week after the autumn term starts, submit the form, HSK transcript, fee receipts and the previous year's transcript to the international education college.

guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.name: GDUFS International Student Scholarship
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.coverage: Full waiver or 50% of tuition for new and continuing degree and Chinese-language students
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.description: Four merit awards: outstanding degree students (new and continuing) and outstanding Chinese-language students. Full awards waive tuition for a year (degree) or semester (language); half awards cover 50%. Results are announced by the end of August.
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.eligibility: No other Chinese government or other scholarship. New students need excellent records and language scores; continuing degree students need an average of 90+, no course below 80, top 30% rank and 90% attendance; language students need over a year of study and top 30% results.
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.how_to_apply: Between 1 May and 30 June each year submit the form, registration documents and a recommendation (new) or transcript and evaluation (continuing) to the admissions office.

guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.name: Guangdong Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (via GDUFS)
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.description: A provincial scholarship with candidates selected by the university and approved by the Guangdong Department of Education; the page says the latest notice takes precedence.
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.eligibility: Outstanding enrolled or incoming bachelor's, master's or doctoral students with strong grades and attendance and a clear study plan, with no other Chinese government scholarship that year.
guangdong-university-of-foreign-studies.how_to_apply: Download the current-student or new-student form and submit it in person or by email between 1 May and 30 June each year.

harbin-normal-university.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Scholarship (Harbin Normal University)
harbin-normal-university.coverage: Tuition, double dorm and medical insurance; doctoral allowance 3,500 RMB a month
harbin-normal-university.description: Heilongjiang funding for outstanding foreign students: bachelor's 4 years, master's 2 to 3, doctoral 3. Only doctoral students get a living allowance, and travel is self-paid. Read from an archived copy.
harbin-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen for four years or more, healthy, not already studying in China. Bachelor's: 25 or under; master's: bachelor's degree under 35; doctoral: master's degree under 40; two professor recommendations for graduates; HSK 4 or 5.
harbin-normal-university.how_to_apply: Mail the provincial form, notarised diploma and transcript, HSK certificate, a study plan of 800 to 1,000 words, recommendations, medical record and passport copy in duplicate by 1 May each year.

beijing-international-studies-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (BISU, new students)
beijing-international-studies-university.coverage: Category A: tuition, housing, allowance, insurance; B: no allowance; C: tuition and insurance
beijing-international-studies-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship awarded to new degree students for the first year and reapplied for each later year on academic results.
beijing-international-studies-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no criminal record. Bachelor's under 25, master's under 35. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programs; Category A needs a top-500 university or key high school (average 85 or GPA 3.6), B and C an average of 80 or GPA 3.0.
beijing-international-studies-university.how_to_apply: Register on the application system, choose the local government scholarship and upload the form, diploma, transcripts, medical form, study plan and two recommendations (master's); the university sets the category.

sichuan-agricultural-university.name: Sichuan Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students
sichuan-agricultural-university.coverage: Yearly stipend: doctoral 30,000, master's 25,000, bachelor's 20,000, language 10,000 RMB
sichuan-agricultural-university.description: A Sichuan provincial scholarship administered by the international college, running the program length (4, 3, 4 and 1 years) and renewed after an annual review.
sichuan-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, friendly to China, healthy with excellent grades and no other Chinese government scholarship. Doctoral under 40, master's under 35, bachelor's under 30, language under 45; HSK 4 or 5 or an English score by level.
sichuan-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Apply online and upload the documents; results come by email, and renewal documents are due between 15 and 30 June each year.

sichuan-agricultural-university.name: Chengdu Friendship City Scholarship (via Sichuan Agricultural University)
sichuan-agricultural-university.coverage: Yearly: doctoral 30,000, master's 25,000, bachelor's 20,000 RMB; language 1,000 a month
sichuan-agricultural-university.description: A Chengdu government scholarship for students from Chengdu's friendship cities, administered by the university; language students get at most 10,000 RMB a year.
sichuan-agricultural-university.eligibility: Citizen of a Chengdu friendship city, friendly to China and healthy with good grades; no other government scholarship. Age limits 40, 35, 30 and 45 by level.
sichuan-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Complete the online form, upload the materials and include the friendship-city identity confirmation letter.

sichuan-agricultural-university.name: Chengdu Belt and Road Government Scholarship (via Sichuan Agricultural University)
sichuan-agricultural-university.coverage: Yearly stipend: doctoral 30,000, master's 25,000, bachelor's 20,000 RMB; language 1,000 a month
sichuan-agricultural-university.description: A Chengdu municipal stipend for students from Belt and Road countries; the page does not say whether tuition is covered.
sichuan-agricultural-university.eligibility: Citizen of a Belt and Road country, friendly to China and healthy with good conduct and grades; no other government scholarship. Age limits 40, 35, 30 and 45 by level.
sichuan-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Complete the online form and upload the materials as instructed.

yunnan-agricultural-university.name: Yunnan Agricultural University Foreign Student Scholarship (categories A and B)
yunnan-agricultural-university.coverage: A: full tuition (6,000 to 10,000 RMB a year) plus 1,200 RMB dorm; B: half tuition
yunnan-agricultural-university.description: The university's own scholarship for full-time degree students, new or current, running the admitted study period. The 2026-27 round planned 11 category A places and 3 category B places.
yunnan-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, with good grades and no other scholarship. Bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK 4 (180+) in principle.
yunnan-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the registration site and mail the paper documents to the international college; the 2026-27 round closed on 30 June.

yunnan-agricultural-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (via Yunnan Agricultural University)
yunnan-agricultural-university.coverage: Yunnan provincial scholarship; amounts not stated on this page
yunnan-agricultural-university.description: A provincial scholarship for degree and non-degree students, mainly from South and Southeast Asia; the university pre-selects and Yunnan's education department approves.
yunnan-agricultural-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese and healthy. Bachelor's: high school, under 25. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. Language students under 35. HSK 4 (180+) except for language students.
yunnan-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: Mail the provincial form, passport, notarised diplomas and transcripts, HSK certificate, study plan, recommendations, CSCA scores (bachelor's), medical form, police certificate, financial proof and a three to five minute video to the international college.

beijing-university-of-technology.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Beijing University of Technology)
beijing-university-of-technology.coverage: Category A: tuition, housing, allowance, insurance; B: no allowance; C: tuition and insurance
beijing-university-of-technology.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship awarded through the university to degree, preparatory and visiting students, for up to the standard program length.
beijing-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy with no criminal record. Bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40. HSK 3 or 4 for Chinese-taught programs; Category A also needs TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5 and a top-500 university; B and C need an average of 80 or GPA 3.0.
beijing-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Submit documents and pay the application fee on the online system; after pre-admission candidates are listed and notified.

beijing-foreign-studies-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (BFSU, new students)
beijing-foreign-studies-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, allowance, insurance; B: no allowance; C: tuition and insurance
beijing-foreign-studies-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship for students who applied to a self-funded program; tuition covers one academic year, and bachelor's, master's and non-degree students generally get class C while doctoral students may get class B.
beijing-foreign-studies-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, friendly to China and healthy. Bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK 3 for non-degree and HSK 4 for degree study; prior average of 80 or GPA 3.0.
beijing-foreign-studies-university.how_to_apply: Download the scholarship form from the study site and upload it with the diploma, transcripts, language proof and CSCA report (bachelor's); selection is by document review and an examination. Deadlines are 30 November (spring) and 5 June (autumn).

beijing-foreign-studies-university.name: BFSU International Student Scholarship (current students)
beijing-foreign-studies-university.description: The university's own merit scholarship for enrolled degree students, paid as a lump sum; selection combines the student's application, a school recommendation and a review of grades, attendance and conduct.
beijing-foreign-studies-university.eligibility: Enrolled in a degree program and registered on time, law-abiding, friendly to China with strong grades and good attendance.
beijing-foreign-studies-university.how_to_apply: Log in to the online service system and complete the scholarship form; winners are published and awards are final if no objection arises.

fujian-normal-university.name: Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship (Fujian Normal University)
fujian-normal-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance and a stipend of 800, 1,200 or 1,600 RMB a month for 11 months
fujian-normal-university.description: A Fujian provincial scholarship the university recruits for; the monthly stipend is 800 RMB for bachelor's, 1,200 for master's and 1,600 for doctoral students.
fujian-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holder, generally under 25 for bachelor's (high-school diploma), under 35 for master's, under 40 for doctoral; no criminal record; bachelor's applicants take the CSCA; Chinese-origin applicants must meet the residence rule.
fujian-normal-university.how_to_apply: Email the completed form and scanned documents to the admissions office; the university reviews, interviews shortlisted applicants and admits by program preference. The 2026 deadline was 30 May.

yunnan-normal-university.name: RCEP Good-Neighbour Talent Scholarship (Yunnan Normal University)
yunnan-normal-university.coverage: Bachelor's tuition (15,000 RMB a year), free dorm and a 1,000 RMB monthly stipend for ten months
