yunnan-normal-university.description: For Chinese-taught bachelor's study in Primary Education at the Southeast Asia College of the Global Teacher Development Institute, 3+1 years or 1+3+1 with a preparatory year; funding is capped at the standard length of study.
yunnan-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese aged 18 to 30 with a high-school diploma and good grades, HSK 4 (180) or a preparatory course first, and a CSCA score report; no other scholarship.
yunnan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system and upload the form, passport, notarised diploma and transcripts, HSK, CSCA, study plan, medical form and police clearance; an expert panel decides.

yunnan-normal-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (via Yunnan Normal University)
yunnan-normal-university.coverage: Tuition, dorm, insurance and a stipend of 1,400, 1,700 or 2,000 RMB a month
yunnan-normal-university.description: A Yunnan provincial scholarship administered by the university, mainly for students from Belt and Road countries and South and Southeast Asia, with other countries also considered.
yunnan-normal-university.eligibility: Bachelor's: high-school diploma, HSK 4 (180+), 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, HSK 5 (180+), 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, HSK 5 (180+), 40 or under.
yunnan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system and upload the generated form, passport, notarised diplomas and transcripts, HSK, study plan, two referee letters for graduates, medical form and police clearance; results are posted in July.

yunnan-normal-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Scholarship for Overseas Students of Chinese Origin
yunnan-normal-university.coverage: Full tuition waiver, or half tuition plus a free three-person dorm; insurance included
yunnan-normal-university.description: A provincial award for overseas students of Chinese origin. The first tier waives tuition and registration fees; the second halves tuition, waives registration and gives free housing.
yunnan-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen of Chinese origin in good health. Bachelor's: high-school diploma (HSK 4), 25 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, HSK 5, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, HSK 5, 40 or under.
yunnan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system and upload the form, passport, notarised documents, HSK, study plan, recommendations for graduates, medical form and police clearance.

dalian-polytechnic-university.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (doctoral, Dalian Polytechnic University, 2026)
dalian-polytechnic-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, medical insurance and living costs for three years
dalian-polytechnic-university.description: A provincial scholarship for doctoral students in Textile Science and Engineering, Light Industry Technology and Engineering, and Food Science and Engineering; it can be taken in Chinese or English.
dalian-polytechnic-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a master's degree or equivalent and strong grades, under 40; English must be a native or official language or shown by TOEFL/IELTS or prior English-medium study.
dalian-polytechnic-university.how_to_apply: Complete the form and select the Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship in the international student system, with a supervisor's acceptance letter where applicable.

taiyuan-university-of-technology.name: Shanxi Province Government Scholarship for International Students (TYUT)
taiyuan-university-of-technology.coverage: Doctoral: tuition and dorm free plus 2,500 a month; master's: tuition free plus 2,000; bachelor's 1,500 a month
taiyuan-university-of-technology.description: A provincial scholarship set up in 2016 with the university as a host. Bachelor's students pay 10,000 RMB tuition and 4,200 housing a year; stipends are paid for ten months and cannot be combined with the university's scholarship in the same year.
taiyuan-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese preparatory, bachelor's, master's or doctoral students who are friendly to China, healthy, of good conduct with good grades and no other scholarship.
taiyuan-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Register on the university's international student system, the route the page states.

taiyuan-university-of-technology.name: Taiyuan University of Technology International Student Scholarship
taiyuan-university-of-technology.coverage: Tuition waived; monthly stipend by level: bachelor's 500 to 1,200, master's 1,000 to 2,000, doctoral 1,500 to 2,500 RMB
taiyuan-university-of-technology.description: A university scholarship in levels A to D with tuition waived (housing paid by the student) and a ten-month stipend by level; reviewed once a year, normally July to September, and new students are ranked from entrance results.
taiyuan-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese preparatory, bachelor's, master's or doctoral students who are friendly to China, healthy and of good conduct with strong academics and no other scholarship.
taiyuan-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Register for admission on the international student system; new students are ranked and levelled by the admissions office.

jiangxi-agricultural-university.name: Jiangxi Provincial Government Scholarship (Jiangxi Agricultural University)
jiangxi-agricultural-university.coverage: Type A 25,000 RMB a year (master's, doctoral); type B 20,000 (bachelor's); type C 6,000 (visiting)
jiangxi-agricultural-university.description: A Jiangxi provincial quota allocated to the university, applied to registration, tuition, housing, materials, internship and insurance; at least 80% of places go to new students.
jiangxi-agricultural-university.eligibility: Freshman applicants should have a good academic base and supply transcripts, papers, language scores and honours.
jiangxi-agricultural-university.how_to_apply: No separate application is described; an assessment group reviews applications, the list is posted publicly and then approved by the provincial education authority.

china-three-gorges-university.name: CTGU Scholarship Programs (2026)
china-three-gorges-university.coverage: Bachelor's first-year tuition covered; clinical medicine 10,000 RMB; master's medicine 5,000 a year
china-three-gorges-university.description: Dated 13 April 2026. English-taught bachelor's programs in Hydraulic Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Automation and Automation get first-year tuition covered with a college review each later year. Bachelor's Clinical Medicine gets 10,000 RMB in two instalments (5,000 in year one, 5,000 after HSK 4); master's Clinical Medicine gets 5,000 RMB a year conditionally.
china-three-gorges-university.eligibility: Applicants admitted to the listed programs; each college controls its own terms.
china-three-gorges-university.how_to_apply: Apply for the listed program on the online international student platform; no separate scholarship procedure is stated.

china-university-of-mining-and-technolog.name: CUMT Scholarship
china-university-of-mining-and-technolog.coverage: Tuition waiver by class; graduate class A also gets housing and 1,000 RMB a month
china-university-of-mining-and-technolog.description: A university scholarship reviewed yearly. Bachelor's class A covers all tuition and class B half; master's and doctoral class A covers tuition, double-room housing (3,000 RMB a year) and 1,000 RMB a month for ten months.
china-university-of-mining-and-technolog.eligibility: New students: average 80+ (or GPA 3.2) for class A, 75+ (or GPA 3.0) for class B. Continuing students need 75+ for A and 65 for bachelor's B, with higher minimums for graduates.
china-university-of-mining-and-technolog.how_to_apply: Apply in the online scholarship system; the Chinese page gives no new window.

northwest-university.name: Xi'an Belt and Road Scholarship (administered by Northwest University)
northwest-university.coverage: Doctoral 25,000, master's 20,000, bachelor's 15,000, language 10,000 RMB a year; first year only
northwest-university.description: A Xi'an city scholarship for students from Belt and Road countries, covering ten months of the first year only; the university does an initial check and the city's education bureau decides.
northwest-university.eligibility: Newly admitted autumn students from Belt and Road countries with an ordinary foreign passport and good health and no other aid. Age limits 30 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral), 45 (language).
northwest-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system, upload the documents and the Xi'an scholarship form and pay the application fee.

northwest-university.name: Xi'an Five Central Asian Countries Scholarship (administered by Northwest University)
northwest-university.coverage: Free tuition and double dorm, 1,800 RMB a month for ten months, insurance and international airfare
northwest-university.description: For bachelor's study (one preparatory year plus four years) in Chinese or English for students from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan.
northwest-university.eligibility: Citizen of one of the five countries with a valid passport, friendly to China, healthy, 25 or under, with a high-school-level diploma and a school recommendation.
northwest-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the online system choosing the Xi'an City Scholarship for preparatory students and pay the 600 RMB fee; documents include the special scholarship form, notarised diploma and transcripts and a study plan of at least 500 words.

nanjing-forestry-university.name: Nanjing Forestry University Scholarship for Incoming Freshmen (2026)
nanjing-forestry-university.coverage: Tuition waiver and insurance; master's and doctoral also free dorm and 1,000 or 1,500 RMB a month
nanjing-forestry-university.description: A scholarship lasting no more than one academic year, renewed on the next year's results. Bachelor's: tuition waiver plus 600 RMB a year insurance. Master's: tuition waiver, free dorm and 1,000 RMB a month for ten months. Doctoral: the same with 1,500 a month.
nanjing-forestry-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a good record. Bachelor's: 18 to 28 with a high-school diploma and CSCA scores. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80; no other Chinese government or organisation scholarship.
nanjing-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site, print and sign the form and mail it with notarised documents to the international college, with e-copies by email; decisions are published before 30 June.

nanjing-forestry-university.name: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship (via Nanjing Forestry University)
nanjing-forestry-university.coverage: Bachelor's 10,000 RMB a year; master's 20,000 RMB a year
nanjing-forestry-university.description: A Nanjing city scholarship for international students at Nanjing universities; the page lists amounts for bachelor's and master's students only.
nanjing-forestry-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health. Bachelor's under 30, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; a good record, compliance with Chinese law, meeting the admission requirements and no other scholarship.
nanjing-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Same route as the freshmen scholarship: apply on the application site, mail the signed form and notarised documents and email e-copies; results are released before 15 July.

wenzhou-university.name: Wenzhou University International Freshman Scholarship
wenzhou-university.coverage: Yearly cash award by tier: bachelor's 6,000 to 18,000, master's 8,000 to 22,000, doctoral 18,000 to 27,000 RMB
wenzhou-university.description: An entry scholarship for new international students, paid after registration for the first year and re-assessed each year under the university's scholarship rules.
wenzhou-university.eligibility: Tier criteria are in the university's regulation, which the page does not reproduce.
wenzhou-university.how_to_apply: No separate application is described; awards are paid after successful registration.

qingdao-university-of-science-and-techno.name: Shandong Provincial Government Scholarship (via QUST)
qingdao-university-of-science-and-techno.coverage: Provincial award for Chinese-taught degree students; amounts not stated; annual review
qingdao-university-of-science-and-techno.description: A Shandong provincial scholarship for international degree students taught in Chinese; recipients must pass an annual review to receive the next year's award.
qingdao-university-of-science-and-techno.eligibility: Bachelor's: high-school diploma, 30 or under. Master's: bachelor's degree, 35 or under. Doctoral: master's degree, 40 or under. Bachelor's applicants need CSCA Chinese and maths scores; master's applicants need two references and a supervisor's acceptance.
qingdao-university-of-science-and-techno.how_to_apply: Apply online with the passport, diplomas, transcripts, study plan, guarantee letter and police certificate; the page says by 30 April every year.

northwestern-polytechnical-university.name: Study at NPU President Scholarship
northwestern-polytechnical-university.coverage: Special: free tuition and housing plus 1,500 to 2,500 RMB a month; first to third: 100%, 50%, 25% tuition
northwestern-polytechnical-university.description: For self-funded new bachelor's, master's and doctoral students in all majors; the stipend is paid for ten months a year.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese with a valid passport and good health. Age by 1 September 2027: bachelor's 23 or under, master's 30, doctoral 35. Bachelor's applicants submit CSCA scores; graduate applicants need an average of 75% or above and Chinese or English proficiency.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's online admission system; bachelor's batches run November 2026 to 20 May 2027 and graduate batches to 30 April 2027.

northwestern-polytechnical-university.name: Xi'an Belt and Road Scholarship (administered by NPU)
northwestern-polytechnical-university.coverage: Full, 50% or 25% tuition plus 1,500 to 2,500 RMB a month; preparatory 1,000 a month
northwestern-polytechnical-university.description: A Xi'an city scholarship for bachelor's, master's, doctoral and preparatory students; the stipend is paid ten months a year, and the preparatory award excludes tuition and housing.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.eligibility: Same age, degree and nationality rules as the President Scholarship, with a previous-stage average of 75% or above and CSCA scores for bachelor's applicants.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university's international admissions, with the same batches as the President Scholarship.

northwestern-polytechnical-university.name: NPU Outstanding International Exchange Student Scholarship
northwestern-polytechnical-university.coverage: Free tuition and housing plus a stipend of 1,500, 2,000 or 2,500 RMB a month
northwestern-polytechnical-university.description: For bachelor's, master's and doctoral exchange or visiting students staying at least three months; a committee selects awardees and results are announced in June or December.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.eligibility: Visiting for three months or more from a global top-300 university or top-100 discipline, or recommended by an honorary professor, or from a partner university with a college-level agreement.
northwestern-polytechnical-university.how_to_apply: Submit materials to the international college for screening; deadlines are 31 May and 15 December each year.

harbin-engineering-university.name: Harbin Engineering University International Student Scholarship
harbin-engineering-university.coverage: Excellence awards: full or half tuition plus a stipend for the top tier; one-off 5,000 RMB talent award
harbin-engineering-university.description: Excellence awards: bachelor's first class full tuition plus 1,500 RMB a month, second full tuition, third half; master's first class full tuition plus 2,000 a month; doctoral first class full tuition plus 3,000 a month; visiting scholars full tuition. A one-off 5,000 RMB talent award goes to new bachelor's students with strong Chinese or special talents, with no application needed.
harbin-engineering-university.eligibility: Friendly to China, good conduct and health. Bachelor's 25 or under, master's 35, doctoral 40; postgraduates need academic ability; visiting scholars 40 (general) or 45 (senior).
harbin-engineering-university.how_to_apply: Other conditions are in each year's application guide; contact the admissions office.

harbin-engineering-university.name: Buminusa-HEU Master's Scholarship (Indonesian students)
harbin-engineering-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, stipend, travel, visa and insurance; about 216,500 RMB; three places a year
harbin-engineering-university.description: Funded by the Bumi Nusantara Group with the university for Indonesian STEM master's students; listed English-taught programs include naval and ocean engineering, marine engineering, control, underwater acoustics, mechanical, nuclear power engineering, maths and optics.
harbin-engineering-university.eligibility: Indonesian citizen under 35 with a STEM bachelor's degree, at least two years of work experience, IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 79, healthy with no criminal record.
harbin-engineering-university.how_to_apply: Apply online with the passport, degree and transcripts, English proof, two references, a research plan, medical form and police certificate.

nankai-university.name: Study at Nankai President's Scholarship
nankai-university.coverage: Amount follows the university's standard for the year; not stated on the page
nankai-university.description: A scholarship for new self-funded students entering bachelor's, master's or doctoral programs.
nankai-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese self-funded applicant to a bachelor's, master's or doctoral program, pre-admitted by the university.
nankai-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student online system and tick the scholarship option; there is no separate application.

nankai-university.name: Tianjin Municipal Government Scholarship (2027 new students, via Nankai)
nankai-university.coverage: Tuition support; level set by Tianjin approval
nankai-university.description: The university nominates pre-admitted self-funded students for the Tianjin scholarship; the grade depends on materials and interview, and the final award follows Tianjin's approval.
nankai-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese self-funded applicant. Bachelor's 25 or under, master's 35, doctoral 40.
nankai-university.how_to_apply: Apply to the university on the online system; pre-admitted students are nominated automatically and told in the admission notice.

beijing-jiaotong-university.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (Beijing Jiaotong University)
beijing-jiaotong-university.coverage: Category A: tuition, housing, allowance, insurance; B: no allowance; C: tuition and insurance
beijing-jiaotong-university.description: A Beijing municipal scholarship awarded in two ways: regular funding for degree and non-degree programs and a competitive Belt and Road Smart Transport program for bachelor's and master's students; it cannot be held with other similar scholarships.
beijing-jiaotong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese with an ordinary passport, healthy, no criminal record. Bachelor's 25 or under (CSCA for freshmen), master's 35, doctoral 40. HSK 5 or IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80; category A also needs IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 85, a top-500 or key university and GPA 3.6/4.0; B and C need GPA 3.0.
beijing-jiaotong-university.how_to_apply: Register on the international student service system, choose a program, pay the fee and upload the scholarship form as an extra attachment.

hebei-normal-university.name: Hebei Provincial Government Scholarship
hebei-normal-university.coverage: Yearly award: 5,000 RMB undergrad, 15,000 master's, 20,000 doctoral (per annual policy)
hebei-normal-university.description: Provincial award for degree students at Hebei universities, administered through the university's international college.
hebei-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese degree students in good health; HSK4 (180+) for undergrad, HSK5 (180+) for master's, HSK5 (180+) or IELTS 6.0 for doctoral.
hebei-normal-university.how_to_apply: Send application form, passport, language score, notarized diploma/transcripts, study plan and two recommendations (graduate level) to the university.

liaoning-technical-university.name: Liaoning Province Government Scholarship (new PhD students)
liaoning-technical-university.coverage: Provincial award for new PhD students; amount not stated on the page
liaoning-technical-university.description: Province-funded scholarship for newly enrolling doctoral students, handled by the university's international school.
liaoning-technical-university.eligibility: Foreign national with a recognized master's degree, aged 40 or under, strong academics, no other Chinese government scholarship.
liaoning-technical-university.how_to_apply: Deliver the full document package (form, notarized degree/transcripts, 1,000-word research proposal, two recommendations, physical exam form) to the international school and email scans.

shanghai-conservatory-of-music.name: SHCM International Student Scholarships (Class A/B/C) and Grant
shanghai-conservatory-of-music.coverage: Class A/B for exchange/short-term students; Class C 4,000 RMB/yr; needs-based grant 6,000 RMB/yr
shanghai-conservatory-of-music.description: University awards: A (tuition, housing, insurance, stipend) and B (tuition and insurance) for exchange or short-term students; C for degree students; plus a hardship grant.
shanghai-conservatory-of-music.eligibility: Non-Chinese nationals in good health with no other Chinese government scholarship; Class C for degree students with excellent records; grant for degree students from needy families.
shanghai-conservatory-of-music.how_to_apply: Submit form, notarized degree, transcripts, two recommendations, study proposal and portfolio to the International Students Office (grant: family financial certificate instead).

huaqiao-university.name: HQU scholarships for freshmen (Fujian Government, Tanoto, Overseas Students Special, others)
huaqiao-university.coverage: Fujian award 30,000 RMB; Tanoto 30,000 RMB/yr; special award half or full tuition
huaqiao-university.description: The 2025 guide lists a Fujian provincial award (about 30 places), Tanoto Belt and Road awards for Maritime Silk Road students, and a special award for outstanding freshmen.
huaqiao-university.eligibility: Outstanding international freshmen; Tanoto restricted to ethnic Chinese from Maritime Silk Road countries in listed schools; Indonesian 1+4 variant.
huaqiao-university.how_to_apply: Guide gives no separate steps; scholarships go with the admission application (admissions.hqu.edu.cn); contact hquwz@hqu.edu.cn.

huaqiao-university.name: HQU scholarships for non-freshmen
huaqiao-university.coverage: Wang Bincheng 1,000-5,000; Huang Zhongxian 3,000-5,000; Lin Wei 3,000-6,000; hardship 1,000-2,000 RMB/yr
huaqiao-university.description: Yearly awards and hardship grants for continuing overseas Chinese and international students.
huaqiao-university.eligibility: Continuing students; some awards restricted to overseas Chinese or Cambodian students; grant for those in financial difficulty.
huaqiao-university.how_to_apply: Not described in the guide; contact the admissions office.

china-pharmaceutical-university.name: Nanjing Government Scholarship
china-pharmaceutical-university.coverage: 10,000 RMB/yr bachelor's; 20,000 RMB/yr master's/PhD; 5,000 RMB half-year visitors
china-pharmaceutical-university.description: City-funded award for new international students at CPU, selected by the admissions committee (2025 intake notice).
china-pharmaceutical-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; under 25 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (PhD); supervisor acceptance for graduate applicants.
china-pharmaceutical-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at admission.cpu.edu.cn with passport, notarized diplomas, language report, 800+ word plan, financial statement, medical and no-crime documents.

china-pharmaceutical-university.name: CPU President Scholarship (undergraduate)
china-pharmaceutical-university.coverage: 19,000-20,000 RMB per year for four years toward tuition
china-pharmaceutical-university.description: Partial tuition award for undergraduates; does not cover housing, insurance or living costs (2025 notice).
china-pharmaceutical-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese high school graduates under 25; HSK5, or IELTS 6.5/TOEFL iBT 90 for English-taught programs.
china-pharmaceutical-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at admission.cpu.edu.cn with the standard document set.

south-china-normal-university.name: Guangdong Province Outstanding International Student Scholarship
south-china-normal-university.description: Provincial one-off award for admitted self-funded students listed in SCNU's 2026 undergraduate brochure.
south-china-normal-university.how_to_apply: Page gives no separate procedure; contact hscic7@scnu.edu.cn.

zhejiang-normal-university.name: ZJNU Scholarship for International Students (Types A/B/C)
zhejiang-normal-university.coverage: Full tuition, half tuition, or 4,500 RMB; no monthly stipend
zhejiang-normal-university.description: University merit awards for new degree students at all levels.
zhejiang-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; under 30 (undergrad), 35 (master's), 40 (PhD); language proof; no other scholarship.
zhejiang-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at admission.zjnu.edu.cn; reviewers select; two recommendations for graduate levels.

zhejiang-normal-university.name: Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship
zhejiang-normal-university.coverage: 30,000 RMB/yr graduate; 20,000 RMB/yr undergraduate; no stipend
zhejiang-normal-university.description: Province-funded yearly award, renewed after annual review.
zhejiang-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese aged 18+, healthy; high school diploma plus CSCA transcript, bachelor's or master's depending on level.
zhejiang-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at admission.zjnu.edu.cn (Feb 1 to Jun 30, no year given).

northeast-forestry-university.name: NEFU President Scholarship (Freshman)
northeast-forestry-university.coverage: One-year award: tuition+housing, tuition, 50% or 30% tuition
northeast-forestry-university.description: Four-tier award for self-financed freshmen in Chinese-taught programs; renewable by performance.
northeast-forestry-university.eligibility: Self-financed non-Chinese applicants to Chinese-taught bachelor's/master's with HSK4; no combining with other awards.
northeast-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Submit form, notarized diploma, transcripts, 800+ word plan, recommendations, passport, physical exam to the international school.

northeast-forestry-university.name: Scholarship Program for International Students from Eurasian Countries
northeast-forestry-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, insurance 800 RMB/yr, stipend 3,000 (master's) or 3,500 (PhD)/month
northeast-forestry-university.description: Full award for graduate students from Eurasian countries.
northeast-forestry-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; master's under 35, PhD under 40; HSK4 or IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 95; no other scholarship.
northeast-forestry-university.how_to_apply: Apply via CSC system (Type B, agency 10225) and istudy.nefu.edu.cn, November to February yearly.

university-of-international-business-and.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (via UIBE)
university-of-international-business-and.coverage: Sponsors tuition for international students; amount not on page
university-of-international-business-and.description: Beijing municipal tuition sponsorship administered by UIBE's School of International Education.
university-of-international-business-and.eligibility: International students at Beijing institutions; no further terms on page.
university-of-international-business-and.how_to_apply: Get the application form from UIBE admissions office or website and apply through UIBE; window listed as Feb 1 to May 30 yearly.

university-of-international-business-and.name: UIBE Scholarship
university-of-international-business-and.coverage: Semi-annual and annual merit awards; amounts not stated
university-of-international-business-and.description: Awards for excellent freshmen, study progress, research and others for enrolled international students.
university-of-international-business-and.eligibility: International students in degree or non-degree programs with strong exams, coursework or service.

shanghai-maritime-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (2027 intake, Type A/B)
shanghai-maritime-university.coverage: A: tuition, housing, 2,500-3,500 RMB/month, insurance; B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-maritime-university.description: City-funded scholarship for new undergraduate, master's and doctoral students, reviewed annually.
shanghai-maritime-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; under 25 (undergrad), 35 (master's), 40 (PhD); strong academics; no other Chinese scholarship.
shanghai-maritime-university.how_to_apply: Sign the application form and upload it at gjy.shmtu.edu.cn.

inner-mongolia-normal-university.name: IMNU self-funded student tuition scholarships
inner-mongolia-normal-university.coverage: Source award 50-100% tuition by HSK; class awards 80-100% tuition after one year
inner-mongolia-normal-university.description: Tuition-share awards for self-funded degree students per the 2026 brochure.
inner-mongolia-normal-university.eligibility: HSK4 gives 50%, HSK5+ gives 100% (source award); class criteria not given.
inner-mongolia-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply as self-funded student at imnu.at0086.cn; no separate scholarship form.

guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.name: China-ASEAN College of Intelligent Technology Specialized Scholarship
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.coverage: Four tiers: tuition+housing+stipend down to 50% tuition
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.description: Tiered award for ASEAN students entering the China-ASEAN College (2026 intake).
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.eligibility: ASEAN citizens; bachelor's need CSCA and interview; graduate recommendations, plan, PhD papers.
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.how_to_apply: Register at admission.guet.edu.cn and email materials to guet-overseas@guet.edu.cn.

guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.name: MOE and Guangxi Scholarship for ASEAN Students (Category B)
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.coverage: Tuition and housing waiver, allowance, medical insurance
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.description: Joint ministry/Guangxi award for ASEAN students at GUET (2026-27 guide).
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.eligibility: ASEAN citizens; age under 25/35/40 by level; CSCA for undergrads; HSK4 180+ for Chinese programs.
guilin-university-of-electronic-technolo.how_to_apply: Apply at campuschina.org, agency 10595, Category B.

zhejiang-university-of-technology.name: ZJUT Scholarship (Excellence / Merit / Friendly / Encouragement)
zhejiang-university-of-technology.coverage: Tuition for full programme, 1 year or 1 semester, or RMB 3,500, depending on tier; no housing or living costs
zhejiang-university-of-technology.description: Tiered tuition awards for new international bachelor's and master's students: the top tier pays tuition for the whole programme (renewed after annual review), lower tiers pay one year or one semester, and the smallest is a fixed RMB 3,500.
zhejiang-university-of-technology.eligibility: Bachelor's or master's applicants in any teaching language; must obey Chinese law and school rules, have no criminal record, keep good grades and complete admission and registration.
zhejiang-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Tick yes to the scholarship question in the ZJUT online application system; evaluation is automatic after document checks, result shown in the pre-admission letter; accept and pay tuition to secure the place.

zhejiang-university-of-technology.name: ZJUT PhD Scholarship / PhD Full Scholarship
zhejiang-university-of-technology.coverage: Tuition and double-room housing; Full version adds RMB 3,500/month stipend
zhejiang-university-of-technology.description: Awards for international PhD students in the university's advantaged doctoral programmes, lasting for the standard programme length. Only 3 Full places; regular scholarships are not capped.
zhejiang-university-of-technology.eligibility: PhD applicants; selection favours master's average above 85, graduation from a global top-600 university, strong SCI/EI publications, and Chinese-taught programmes. Renewal needs minimum GPA, attendance and paper requirements.
zhejiang-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Answer yes to the scholarship question in the ZJUT application system, accept the award and pay tuition as instructed, then register with the certificate.

sichuan-international-studies-university.name: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship (SISU guide, 2022 cycle)
sichuan-international-studies-university.coverage: First prize: full tuition + RMB 1,000/month for 10 months; second prize: RMB 10,000 tuition/year
sichuan-international-studies-university.description: Chongqing city award for undergraduate and master's students at SISU, with two prize levels. Page is a 2022 guide and may be out of date.
sichuan-international-studies-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; undergraduates under 25 with high-school completion; master's applicants under 35 with a bachelor's; HSK 5 (180+) for Chinese-taught programmes.
sichuan-international-studies-university.how_to_apply: Submit documents in the SISU International Student Service System (forms, passport, no-crime record, physical exam, diplomas, language certificate, study plan, recommendation letters); SISU screens and forwards to the Chongqing Education Commission.

beijing-university-of-chemical-technolog.name: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students
beijing-university-of-chemical-technolog.coverage: Tuition for one year or half a year; no housing, stipend or insurance
beijing-university-of-chemical-technolog.description: Beijing municipal tuition award handled via BUCT for outstanding international students already in degree study; renewed after annual review.
beijing-university-of-chemical-technolog.eligibility: Outstanding students enrolled in a degree programme; holders of the Chinese Government Scholarship are excluded.
beijing-university-of-chemical-technolog.how_to_apply: Register at study.buct.edu.cn, complete the online application; School of International Education assesses the materials.

hainan-university.name: Hainan Provincial Government International Student Scholarship (2026-2027)
hainan-university.coverage: Free registration, tuition, medical insurance and on-campus housing; other costs self-paid
hainan-university.description: Provincial partial scholarship for new full-time degree students, administered by Hainan University; annual evaluation to continue.
hainan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; under 30 (bachelor), 35 (master), 40 (doctor); HSK 4 over 180 for Chinese-taught, or TOEFL 78 iBT / IELTS 6.0 for English-taught; not for native or third-language studies.
hainan-university.how_to_apply: Complete the online application with scanned documents: form, passport, notarized diploma and transcripts, language certificate, physical exam, two recommendations, study plan, non-criminal record, CV.

anshan-normal-university.name: ANU Principal's Scholarship (degree students)
anshan-normal-university.coverage: Amount and coverage not stated on the page
anshan-normal-university.description: University scholarship option for degree-seeking international students applying to Anshan Normal University.
anshan-normal-university.eligibility: Degree applicants meeting general requirements: non-Chinese, age and education limits, HSK 4 (180+) unless in the Chinese language bachelor.
anshan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the Principal's Scholarship application form and email it with application materials to anulxs@163.com.

anshan-normal-university.name: ANU Belt and Road Scholarship (non-degree students)
anshan-normal-university.coverage: Amount and coverage not stated on the page
anshan-normal-university.description: University scholarship option for non-degree international students.
anshan-normal-university.eligibility: Non-degree applicants meeting the general admission requirements.
anshan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Fill in the Belt and Road scholarship form and email it with application materials to anulxs@163.com.

xiangtan-university.name: Hunan Provincial Scholarship for Belt and Road Chinese-language learners
xiangtan-university.coverage: Tuition, accommodation, insurance and textbook fees
xiangtan-university.description: Hunan Education Department award for one-year non-degree Chinese study, applied for directly through Xiangtan University.
xiangtan-university.eligibility: Students from Belt and Road countries studying Chinese for one academic year, not already enrolled in a Hunan school.
xiangtan-university.how_to_apply: Use the application form attached to the brochure; confirm the submission process with the International Students Affairs Office.

university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t.name: Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship (USST page, 2023/24 cycle)
university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t.coverage: Type A: tuition, housing, insurance; Type B: tuition and insurance
university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t.description: Shanghai city scholarship administered through USST: Type A full award for master's/doctoral, Type B partial for bachelor's to doctoral.
university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to USST; HSK 4 for Chinese-taught programmes; master's/doctoral need two recommendations and a supervisor acceptance letter.
university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t.how_to_apply: Apply on the Study in Shanghai portal choosing USST, pay RMB 800 fee, upload documents (diplomas, study plan, passport, health records, no-crime certificate, video).

east-china-university-of-political-scien.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students (2027 intake)
east-china-university-of-political-scien.coverage: Cat. A: tuition, housing, insurance, RMB 2,500-3,500/month; Cat. B: tuition and insurance
east-china-university-of-political-scien.description: Shanghai city scholarship handled through ECUPL, in a full (A) and partial (B) category.
east-china-university-of-political-scien.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; master's under 35, doctoral under 40; no other Chinese government scholarship at the same time.
east-china-university-of-political-scien.how_to_apply: Apply online via the Study in Shanghai portal; results emailed.

yunnan-minzu-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (2025 intake page)
yunnan-minzu-university.coverage: Provincial degree scholarship; page gives no benefit amounts
yunnan-minzu-university.description: Provincial scholarship for bachelor's, master's and doctoral students, aimed mainly at South and Southeast Asia, recommended by YMU to the Yunnan Education Department.
yunnan-minzu-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, HSK 4+; under 25 (bachelor), 35 (master), 40 (doctoral).
yunnan-minzu-university.how_to_apply: Complete the YMU online application plus scholarship form with passport, notarized degrees, HSK, recommendations, study plan, physical and no-crime record; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

university-of-jinan.name: UJN Undergraduate Scholarship
university-of-jinan.coverage: Half of tuition and half of accommodation fees for the full programme; 30 places
university-of-jinan.description: University-funded partial award for new bachelor students, covering a one-year Chinese preparatory year plus the degree (five years for Urban and Rural Planning).
university-of-jinan.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, high-school graduate with good grades and under 25; HSK4 180+ for Chinese-taught, or English proof (e.g. IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 70, Duolingo 100) for English-taught programmes.
university-of-jinan.how_to_apply: Apply via the UJN online admission system with passport, medical report, bank statement, no-criminal-record certificate, diploma/transcript, language and CSCA results; 400 CNY fee; page deadline June 10 (no year).

university-of-jinan.name: Shandong Provincial Government Scholarship (UJN)
university-of-jinan.coverage: Tuition, accommodation, insurance and a living allowance (page lists 1,000 undergrad / 1,200 master's)
university-of-jinan.description: Provincial full-type award for bachelor and master students, administered through UJN.
university-of-jinan.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; master's applicants hold a bachelor's and are under 35; HSK4 for Chinese-taught or English proof for English-taught; undergraduates need a CSCA result.
university-of-jinan.how_to_apply: Apply in the UJN online system; upload passport, certificates, medical report, no-criminal-record certificate; master's also need study plan, two referee letters, supervisor acceptance; deadline June 10 (no year).

university-of-jinan.name: Jinan International Sister-city Scholarship
university-of-jinan.coverage: Medical insurance, tuition and accommodation for language or degree study
university-of-jinan.description: Jinan city award for students from the city's sister cities, administered by UJN.
university-of-jinan.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, aged 18-40 for degrees (18-60 non-degree), high-school diploma or higher, recommended by their local government's international affairs office; language requirements as for UJN programmes.
university-of-jinan.how_to_apply: Get the local government recommendation, then apply online at the UJN admission system with documents; no deadline listed.

xinjiang-university.name: Xinjiang Government Scholarship for Neighboring Countries
xinjiang-university.coverage: Fees waived, campus housing 10 months, insurance, stipend 1,000/1,220/1,500 RMB per month
xinjiang-university.description: Xinjiang regional government award for students from neighbouring countries, run by Xinjiang University (2026 cycle).
xinjiang-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; bachelor under 25 with high-school diploma, master under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK4+ (HSK5+ for Chinese-taught graduate) or English proof; not holding another Chinese government scholarship.
xinjiang-university.how_to_apply: Register on the university's International Students Management Platform; CSCA for undergraduates; supervisor pre-admission letter and study plan for graduates; notarized documents; interview. 2026 deadline was 2026-05-31 (past).

tianjin-foreign-studies-university.name: TFSU International Students Scholarship for New Applicants
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.description: University award for new degree students, selected after exam and interview (2025 cycle shown).
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; bachelor under 30, master under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK4/5/6 or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80 for English-taught; no other scholarship that year.
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.how_to_apply: Apply online in the admissions portal choosing the TFSU Scholarship category; document review, written test and interview.

tianjin-foreign-studies-university.name: Tianjin Government Scholarship (TFSU)
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.description: Tianjin city scholarship for new international degree students at TFSU.
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; bachelor under 30, master under 35, doctoral under 40; no other scholarship that year.
tianjin-foreign-studies-university.how_to_apply: Apply through the university online system with notarized degree, transcripts, referee letters (graduate), medical record; window typically March-June.

qiqihar-university.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Scholarship (Qiqihar)
qiqihar-university.coverage: Registration, tuition, lab fees, textbooks, accommodation and insurance
qiqihar-university.description: Provincial award with yearly quotas for selected undergraduate and master's programmes.
qiqihar-university.eligibility: Undergraduate: senior-high level, strong grades, under 25; master: bachelor's, up to 35; limited programme list.
qiqihar-university.how_to_apply: Contact admissions and submit documents; college review, provincial approval, then JW202 issued.

yanshan-university.name: YSU President Scholarship
yanshan-university.description: University award for self-funded international students.
yanshan-university.eligibility: Self-funded; needs HSK5 or IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 85/Duolingo 105, or competition awards, high-school average above 75, or certified talent; no CSC holders.
yanshan-university.how_to_apply: Submit form and notarized documents to School of International Education; committee review and public notice; deadline May 20 (no year).

hebei-university.name: Hebei Province Government Scholarship (HBU)
hebei-university.coverage: Tuition support: doctoral 20,000, master 15,000, undergrad 5,000, language 2,500 RMB/yr
hebei-university.description: Provincial tuition award reviewed each semester.
hebei-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holder (not HK/Macau/Taiwan); meets HBU admission rules (age limits 40/35/25); no CSC or Confucius scholarship.
hebei-university.how_to_apply: Page gives no steps; contact the International Student Management Office.

hebei-university.name: Hebei University President Scholarship
hebei-university.coverage: 16,000-49,500 RMB per year depending on level and field
hebei-university.description: University award for full-time degree students.
hebei-university.eligibility: Applicant or admitted international full-time student; CSC and Confucius winners excluded; must keep passing courses.
hebei-university.how_to_apply: Page gives no steps; contact the college.

northeast-electric-power-university.name: Jilin Provincial Government Scholarship (NEEPU)
northeast-electric-power-university.coverage: Free tuition and dorm, 1,700 RMB/month for 4 semesters, insurance
northeast-electric-power-university.description: Partial provincial award for master's and doctoral students.
northeast-electric-power-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; master's under 35 with bachelor's, doctoral under 40 with master's.
northeast-electric-power-university.how_to_apply: After January 1 apply in the admission system and email PDFs to the contact; includes plan and two referee letters; deadline June 30 (no year).

china-university-of-petroleum-beijing.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (CUPB)
china-university-of-petroleum-beijing.coverage: Class I: tuition, housing, insurance, 2,500 RMB/month x10; Class II: no allowance
china-university-of-petroleum-beijing.description: Beijing award for freshmen from 2024 on, administered by CUPB.
china-university-of-petroleum-beijing.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no record; IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 75 or HSK4 (undergrad), HSK5 or IELTS 6.5 (graduate); ages 25/35/45.
china-university-of-petroleum-beijing.how_to_apply: Apply online at cie-registration.cup.edu.cn with transcripts above 70%, study plan, medical and police certificates; undergraduate by May 15, graduate by May 30 (no year).

fujian-agriculture-and-forestry-universi.name: Fujian Government Scholarship and FAFU Scholarship
fujian-agriculture-and-forestry-universi.coverage: Tuition plus monthly allowance 1,500/2,000/2,500 RMB; insurance
fujian-agriculture-and-forestry-universi.description: Provincial and university awards with annual review for degree students.
fujian-agriculture-and-forestry-universi.eligibility: Non-CSC overseas students; FAFU award depends on yearly budget; annual review needed.
fujian-agriculture-and-forestry-universi.how_to_apply: Page gives no steps; see notices or fafuoec@fafu.edu.cn.

shanghai-ocean-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (SHOU, 2027 intake)
shanghai-ocean-university.coverage: Type A: tuition, double room, insurance, stipend; Type B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-ocean-university.description: Shanghai award for bachelor, master and PhD, plus 1+4 Chinese preparatory option.
shanghai-ocean-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, GPA above 3.0; bachelor under 26, master 30, PhD 35; CSCA for bachelor.
shanghai-ocean-university.how_to_apply: Apply online (opens 2026-10-01), review and interview; graduate deadline 2027-02-01, bachelor 2027-05-30.

shanghai-ocean-university.name: SHOU University Scholarship Type A (MTI / Area Studies master)
shanghai-ocean-university.eligibility: Bachelor's, age 30 or under; HSK5 or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80; supervisor contact mandatory.
shanghai-ocean-university.how_to_apply: Register at gjxssqxt.cn, pay 400 RMB fee, online interview.

heilongjiang-university-of-chinese-medic.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Scholarship (HLJUCM)
heilongjiang-university-of-chinese-medic.coverage: Fees, tuition, textbooks, housing and insurance waived
heilongjiang-university-of-chinese-medic.description: Provincial award for bachelor, master and doctoral students.
heilongjiang-university-of-chinese-medic.eligibility: Non-Chinese with 4+ years nationality, not already in China; ages 25/35/40; referee letters for graduates.
heilongjiang-university-of-chinese-medic.how_to_apply: Submit application form, notarized degree, transcript, 800-word plan, passport, medical record.

beijing-technology-and-business-universi.name: Beijing Government Scholarship (BGS)
beijing-technology-and-business-universi.coverage: Tuition remission of 5,000-30,000 RMB per year depending on award level; no cash paid
beijing-technology-and-business-universi.description: Beijing municipal award that reduces tuition for talented international students admitted by Beijing universities; other costs are self-funded.
beijing-technology-and-business-universi.eligibility: International undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and Chinese-language students showing exceptional academic talent.
beijing-technology-and-business-universi.how_to_apply: Download the BGS application form from the BTBU admission site and upload it in the application system while applying to BTBU.

capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.name: New Foreign Student Scholarship
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.coverage: Partial coverage of tuition, accommodation and allowance for the first year
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.description: University award for outstanding newly admitted international students in degree and language programs.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.eligibility: New outstanding international students in degree or language programs.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.how_to_apply: Not stated; contact the International Student Office.

capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.name: Excellent (Academic) Foreign Student Scholarship
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.coverage: Partial coverage of tuition, accommodation and living expenses
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.description: Merit award for continuing degree students.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.eligibility: Degree students who finished a full academic year, follow laws and rules, have no make-up exams or retaken courses, reach the required score and are not extending study.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.how_to_apply: Not stated; contact the International Student Office.

capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.name: Language Program Scholarship
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.coverage: Awards for attendance, diligence, HSK results and learning excellence
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.description: Several award categories for students in the Chinese language program.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.eligibility: Outstanding language students who have studied one or more semesters.
capital-university-of-economics-and-busi.how_to_apply: Not stated; contact the International Student Office.

central-conservatory-of-music.name: Scholarship for International Students in Beijing (Beijing Government Scholarship)
central-conservatory-of-music.coverage: Tuition remission, full or half, up to 4 years for degree students
central-conservatory-of-music.description: Beijing municipal fund administered by CCOM that waives tuition; yearly amounts are announced by the International Students' Office. Degree students are prioritized; half-award winners pay the remainder.
central-conservatory-of-music.eligibility: New and registered international students meeting admission criteria; holders of CSC or other scholarships are generally excluded.
central-conservatory-of-music.how_to_apply: New applicants post scholarship materials with admission materials; current students get the form from the International Students' Office and submit via their department.

hainan-normal-university.name: Hainan Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students
hainan-normal-university.description: Provincial scholarship for international students at undergraduate, master's and doctoral level.
hainan-normal-university.eligibility: International undergraduate, master's and doctoral applicants (details not given).
hainan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Submit application to the Admissions Office of the School of International Education within the announced period; see gjwh.hainnu.edu.cn.

hainan-normal-university.name: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
hainan-normal-university.description: Scholarship categories for master's and bachelor's in international Chinese language education and one-year or one-semester Chinese study.
hainan-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply via the Chinese Language Teacher scholarship platform (cis.chinese.cn); cycles May 15 for September and October 31 for March entry (no year given).

yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.name: Da Yi Scholarship for International Students
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.coverage: Annual award of 5,000 RMB each, 5-10 recipients
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.description: In-school bonus for enrolled international students.
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.how_to_apply: Apply after enrolment according to the school's notice.

yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.coverage: Coverage not stated on this page
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.description: Provincial scholarship for new international students, administered with the university.
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.eligibility: General entry needs HSK 3 (undergraduate) or HSK 4 (master's/doctoral).
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi.how_to_apply: Apply to YUFE per its published Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship admission notice.

henan-university-of-technology.name: International Student Freshman Scholarship (Autumn 2026)
henan-university-of-technology.coverage: First class: full tuition + double room; second: full tuition; third: half tuition
henan-university-of-technology.description: Entrance awards for new students; level set by college academic review and Chinese proficiency. Undergraduate and one-year language tuition is 10,000 yuan per year.
henan-university-of-technology.eligibility: Doctoral: last-degree GPA 3.5+ and at least one high-level paper (first class or lower). Master's: GPA 3.5+; computer science needs top 5% undergraduate rank, applied economics needs an economics background (second class or lower).
henan-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Apply online through the HAUT international student service system (window April-July 2026).

henan-university-of-technology.name: Promotion Scholarship
henan-university-of-technology.coverage: Review-based awards for continuing graduate students; amount per management measures
henan-university-of-technology.description: Yearly review-based scholarship for continuing students.
henan-university-of-technology.eligibility: Doctoral students in years 2-4 and master's students in years 2-3, per the university scholarship management measures (2025 No. 5).
henan-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Through the review process under those measures.

southern-university-of-science-and-techn.name: SUSTech First-Grade Scholarship (postgraduate)
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.coverage: Full tuition and shared-room waiver, insurance, research allowance (master's 2,500; PhD 4,550-5,500 RMB/month)
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.description: Automatic funding for admitted international postgraduates not holding the CSC; up to 3 years master's, 4 years PhD, subject to annual review.
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.eligibility: Admitted international master's and doctoral students without the Chinese Government Scholarship.
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.how_to_apply: Choose this scholarship type in the SUSTech application portal; no extra application after admission.

southern-university-of-science-and-techn.name: Guangdong Provincial Scholarship for Outstanding International Students
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.coverage: One-time first-year supplement of 30,000 RMB (PhD) or 20,000 RMB (master's)
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.description: Provincial supplement for new postgraduates, chosen on academic merit.
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.eligibility: New doctoral and master's students not receiving the CSC.
southern-university-of-science-and-techn.how_to_apply: No separate application; selected along with admission.

xidian-university.name: Huashan Scholarship of Xidian University
xidian-university.coverage: First class: tuition + monthly living (1,200/1,700/2,200 RMB); second: tuition; third: 50% tuition
xidian-university.description: Three-tier partial scholarship for excellent international students.
xidian-university.eligibility: International undergraduate, master's and doctoral students.
xidian-university.how_to_apply: Through Xidian's International Education College site (sie.xidian.edu.cn).

xidian-university.name: Xi'an Municipal Belt and Road Scholarship
xidian-university.description: Partial scholarship from Xi'an city for excellent international students.
xidian-university.eligibility: Undergraduate, master's and doctoral students; non-degree trainees staying 6+ months.
xidian-university.how_to_apply: Through Xidian's International Education College site.

nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.name: NUAA Fly-High Scholarship (postgraduate 2026)
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.coverage: First prize 100% tuition waiver; second 20,000 RMB; third 10,000 RMB; one year
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.description: Entry awards decided at offer stage from background, academics and exam/interview results.
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.how_to_apply: Apply to NUAA; applications open 2025-11-15 to 2026-05-30.

nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.name: Nanjing Government Scholarship (postgraduate 2026)
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.coverage: One-time 20,000 RMB for the first year
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.description: Municipal award given at admission; no tuition or housing cover.
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.how_to_apply: Apply to NUAA; no separate application described.

nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.name: NUAA Academic Scholarship
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.coverage: Up to 20,000 RMB per year for postgraduates
nanjing-university-of-aeronautics-and-as.description: Merit award for continuing students based on yearly GPA and overall review.

shenyang-aerospace-university.name: SAU University Scholarship (Outstanding International Students)
shenyang-aerospace-university.coverage: Cash prizes of CNY 3,000 / 2,000 / 1,500 plus CNY 500 single-item awards
shenyang-aerospace-university.description: Annual merit awards for self-funded undergraduates, ranked by grades (75%) and conduct (25%); a comprehensive prize may be combined with a single-item prize.
shenyang-aerospace-university.eligibility: Self-funded undergraduates enrolled at least one year, no leave of absence, clean conduct record; prior-year averages of 85/80 or no course below 70 depending on tier.
shenyang-aerospace-university.how_to_apply: Submit a written application to the Student Administration Office at the start of each academic year; a committee decides.

shenyang-aerospace-university.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (SAU)
shenyang-aerospace-university.coverage: Tuition waiver, free campus housing, RMB 3,500 monthly stipend
shenyang-aerospace-university.description: Provincial full scholarship for master's-holding foreign nationals, handled through the university online portal; results announced around mid-June.
shenyang-aerospace-university.eligibility: Foreign national in good health, under 40, MOE-recognised master's degree, strong grades, no other scholarship at time of application.
shenyang-aerospace-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at sau.17gz.org with passport copy, notarised diploma/transcript, 1,500+ word proposal, CV, two professor recommendations, medical forms. Window early January to mid-April yearly.

xian-shiyou-university.name: Xi'an Shiyou University Scholarship
xian-shiyou-university.coverage: Five tiers from 100% tuition+housing down to RMB 5,000 fee waiver
xian-shiyou-university.description: Tiered institutional award on tuition and designated housing, reviewed annually for continuation, change, suspension or cancellation.
xian-shiyou-university.eligibility: Not specified separately on the page; applies through the non-CSC route for international applicants.
xian-shiyou-university.how_to_apply: Apply via the XSYU online platform (xsyu.at0086.cn/student) and pay the non-refundable RMB 320 fee; 2026 windows were 1 Mar-30 Jun (undergraduate) and 1 Mar-30 May (graduate).

xian-shiyou-university.name: Xi'an 'Belt and Road' Scholarship
xian-shiyou-university.coverage: Monthly stipend RMB 1,000-2,500 by level, paid 10 months
xian-shiyou-university.eligibility: Not stated separately on the page.
xian-shiyou-university.how_to_apply: Through the XSYU online application platform with the general university-scholarship windows.

xian-shiyou-university.name: Xi'an 'Five Central Asian Countries' Scholarship
xian-shiyou-university.coverage: Tuition, housing, stipend, insurance and international airfare
xian-shiyou-university.description: Full-coverage municipal award adding travel to China, spanning foundation to doctoral study.
xian-shiyou-university.eligibility: Not detailed beyond study levels (implied for students from the five Central Asian countries).
xian-shiyou-university.how_to_apply: Via the XSYU online platform; no separate process stated.

xiamen-university-of-technology.name: XMUT Scholarship
xiamen-university-of-technology.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, RMB 1,800-2,000/month stipend, insurance
xiamen-university-of-technology.description: University full scholarship for admitted students in specified master's (mechanical, management, electronic information, arts) and bachelor's (Chinese International Education, International Business) programmes; reviewed annually. 2025 call page.
xiamen-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; master's under 35, bachelor's under 25 (as of 1 Sep 2025); HSK for Chinese-taught programmes; admission to XMUT first.
xiamen-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: After admission, email full materials to zs@xmut.edu.cn; review plus interview.

hebei-university-of-technology.name: Hebei Provincial Government-HEBUT Scholarship (2026 postgraduate)
hebei-university-of-technology.coverage: Full tuition; living subsidy RMB 20,000 (master) / 30,000 (PhD) per year; housing by tier
hebei-university-of-technology.description: Provincial scholarship administered by HEBUT for English-taught master's and doctoral programmes in listed majors; first-class Type A/B and second-class tiers, annual review from year two.
hebei-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; master's under 30, doctoral under 40; TOEFL 85 or IELTS 6.0; listed majors only.
hebei-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Register at hebut.studyinchina.top, choose the scholarship and major, upload passport, transcripts, language proof, study plan, two recommendations, medical and police clearance forms.

guangzhou-university-of-chinese-medicine.name: Guangdong Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students in Guangdong (continuing students, 2026)
guangzhou-university-of-chinese-medicine.coverage: RMB 30,000 PhD / 20,000 master's / 10,000 bachelor's per person
guangzhou-university-of-chinese-medicine.description: Provincial award allocated to GZUCM (60 places in 2026); funds paid via university finance system.
guangzhou-university-of-chinese-medicine.eligibility: Degree students under 40 with 1+ year of study, good grades and conduct, Chinese proficiency proof, not receiving Chinese government or Confucius Institute scholarships.
guangzhou-university-of-chinese-medicine.how_to_apply: Submit form and documents as a ZIP to the class coordinator (2026: by 15 June), paper copies by 3 September; committee review then provincial approval.

yanbian-university.name: Jilin Provincial Government Scholarship (Yanbian University)
yanbian-university.coverage: 2-year partial: tuition waiver, double room, RMB 1,700/month, basic insurance
yanbian-university.description: Partial provincial scholarship for master's students for two years; later costs at self-funded rates.
yanbian-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, bachelor's degree, under 35, New HSK level 5 or equivalent.
yanbian-university.how_to_apply: Email form, notarised degree/transcript, 800+ character plan, two recommendations, medical form, passport copies, photos, police record to liuxue@ybu.edu.cn; yearly deadline 15 June.

jiangxi-university-of-chinese-medicine.name: Jiangxi Provincial Government Scholarship for Overseas Students
jiangxi-university-of-chinese-medicine.description: Provincial award applied for through the university; schools must add a matching school scholarship of 5% of tuition. Page appears to be older regulations.
jiangxi-university-of-chinese-medicine.eligibility: Doctoral under 40, master's under 35, undergraduate under 25; good health; no other Chinese government scholarship; HK/Macao/Taiwan excluded; current students top of class.
jiangxi-university-of-chinese-medicine.how_to_apply: Submit form, notarised certificates, passport copy, health report, recommendations and study plan to the university; preliminary review January-May, awards each October.

university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.name: Nottingham Global Scholarships (Provost International Excellence 100% / Emerging Leaders 50%)
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.coverage: Equivalent of 100% or 50% of first-year tuition
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.description: Competitive undergraduate award, grades-weighted; recipients give 30 hours of support to university promotion.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.eligibility: Full-time international undergraduate applicants holding a UNNC offer.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.how_to_apply: Separate application via Application Hub: form plus statement up to 500 words.

university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.name: Zhejiang/Ningbo Government Scholarship
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.description: Government-funded first-year tuition support for international undergraduates.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.eligibility: International undergraduate students; no other criteria listed.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.how_to_apply: Application Hub form with roughly 500-word personal statement.

university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.name: CEEC Scholarship
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.description: Automatic award for undergraduates from listed Central and Eastern European countries who pay full tuition.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.eligibility: Full-time undergraduates from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Greece, Hungary, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.how_to_apply: No application; issued automatically before end of first semester.

university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.name: Family Scholarship
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.coverage: 10% tuition reduction for up to 4 years
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.description: Discount for relatives of current or former full-time UNNC students.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.eligibility: Child, sibling or spouse of an enrolled or graduated full-time UNNC award-bearing student.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china.how_to_apply: Apply on Application Hub with proof of family relationship.

shanghai-international-studies-universit.name: SISU Outstanding International Student Scholarship
shanghai-international-studies-universit.coverage: Awards of RMB 30,000 / 20,000 / 5,000 for first/second/third prize
shanghai-international-studies-universit.description: Merit award for enrolled foreign degree students at SISU, ranked in three prize classes (2023 notice).
shanghai-international-studies-universit.eligibility: Enrolled degree student who has paid tuition and registered; good record and attendance, departmental recommendation; no other Chinese government, Shanghai or school scholarship at the same time.
shanghai-international-studies-universit.how_to_apply: Fill in the online application, submit the signed review form from tutor/department, and attach transcripts of the previous two semesters.

shanghai-international-studies-universit.name: SISU-Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship
shanghai-international-studies-universit.coverage: Type A: tuition, housing, insurance, stipend RMB 3,000-3,500/mo; Type B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-international-studies-universit.description: Shanghai government scholarship administered by SISU for new students entering in Sept 2026; Type A for graduates only, Type B for undergraduate and graduate.
shanghai-international-studies-universit.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, new applicants; age limits 25 (bachelor), 35 (master), 40 (doctoral); good record; some professional programs excluded.
shanghai-international-studies-universit.how_to_apply: Apply online at apply.shisu.edu.cn with scholarship form and pay application fee; written exam and interview follow, results in June/July.

hefei-university.name: Hefei University President's Scholarship
hefei-university.coverage: RMB 22,000 per academic year, including the preparatory stage
hefei-university.description: University award for international students at Hefei University who are academically strong and of good conduct.
hefei-university.eligibility: Foreign students friendly to China with good character and academic standing; those with disciplinary violations or failing results are excluded.
hefei-university.how_to_apply: Applications open each June; page gives no procedure, contact the International Education College.

hefei-university.name: Study in Anhui Government Scholarship (Hefei University)
hefei-university.description: Anhui provincial scholarship for international degree students, handled through Hefei University's International Education College.
hefei-university.eligibility: Degree-seeking foreign students, friendly to China, academically excellent, good character.
hefei-university.how_to_apply: Applications open each June via the college's online portal; contact the International Education College for details.

tianjin-university-of-technology.name: Tianjin Municipal Government Scholarship (master's)
tianjin-university-of-technology.coverage: First class RMB 9,900/yr incl. housing; second class RMB 8,300/yr
tianjin-university-of-technology.description: Tianjin government scholarship for full-time master's students at TUT; covers tuition, fees, insurance and allowance (first class also housing). Page shows the 2025 round.
tianjin-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, good record, bachelor's degree, age up to 35, HSK 4 meeting the major's requirement.
tianjin-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Register on the TUT international application system, upload the scholarship form and documents; interview follows.

tianjin-university-of-technology.name: TUT University-Level Scholarship and Grant (master's)
tianjin-university-of-technology.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, RMB 1,000/mo x10; partial: tuition and housing
tianjin-university-of-technology.description: University scholarships for master's students, plus grants for enrolled students; tiered awards of RMB 500-4,000. Page shows the 2024 round.
tianjin-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, good record, no other scholarship, HSK 4 for master's applicants.
tianjin-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Apply via the TUT international application system with the new-student scholarship form and documents.

anhui-normal-university.name: Anhui Normal University Scholarship for International Students
anhui-normal-university.description: Merit scholarship for newly admitted self-funded international degree students, renewable annually with satisfactory results; 4 years undergraduate, 3 years graduate.
anhui-normal-university.eligibility: Newly admitted, self-funded, degree-seeking; selected on academic merit.
anhui-normal-university.how_to_apply: No separate application described; selection made each early June among admitted applicants.

communication-university-of-china.name: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students (CUC)
communication-university-of-china.coverage: Academic-year tuition and comprehensive medical insurance
communication-university-of-china.description: Beijing municipal scholarship administered at CUC for self-funded degree students.
communication-university-of-china.eligibility: Self-funded undergraduate, master's and doctoral students only.
communication-university-of-china.how_to_apply: Follow the annual procedure in the admissions brochure for the relevant year.

shanghai-university-of-finance-and-econo.name: SUFE Semester-Year Scholarship for International Students
shanghai-university-of-finance-and-econo.coverage: RMB 8,000 / 6,000 / 4,000 per semester year by tier
shanghai-university-of-finance-and-econo.description: Merit scholarship for enrolled international students, scored 30% conduct and 70% coursework average (rules revised 2011, posted 2019).
shanghai-university-of-finance-and-econo.eligibility: Registered undergraduate/postgraduate not holding CSC, Shanghai government or corporate scholarships; no failed courses, good attendance, minimum course score 70-75.
shanghai-university-of-finance-and-econo.how_to_apply: Submit the application form to the Student Affairs Department of the International Cultural Exchange College during the September-October evaluation.

shantou-university-medical-college.name: Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship (SUMC)
shantou-university-medical-college.description: Provincial award for postgraduate international students admitted to SUMC; the university committee picks candidates and the Guangdong education department decides, usually in Nov-Dec.
shantou-university-medical-college.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; new students need good record, study plan, two professor reference letters; under 40 (PhD) or 35 (master's); CGS holders excluded; admitted SUMC students only.
shantou-university-medical-college.how_to_apply: Watch for the university notice, normally issued July or August; the committee nominates candidates.

southwest-petroleum-university.name: Study in SWPU Scholarship
southwest-petroleum-university.coverage: Free tuition; PhD +3,000 and master's +2,000 RMB/yr stipend
southwest-petroleum-university.description: University award for admitted or enrolled international students, renewed after an annual review of grades, conduct and attendance.
southwest-petroleum-university.eligibility: Good conduct, no disciplinary or fee problems; good academic record; cannot be combined with a government scholarship.
southwest-petroleum-university.how_to_apply: Submit transcript, department recommendation, publications/awards and supervisor letter; the international office screens and a committee decides.

southwest-petroleum-university.name: Sichuan Provincial / Chengdu Government Scholarships (administered by SWPU)
southwest-petroleum-university.description: Provincial and Chengdu city (Sister City, Belt and Road) awards allocated to SWPU students per the rules page; short-term students get smaller amounts.
southwest-petroleum-university.eligibility: Same general conduct and academic requirements plus each government scheme's own criteria; only one government scholarship at a time.
southwest-petroleum-university.how_to_apply: Apply through SWPU's international office with transcripts and recommendations; timing set by the government authority.

nanjing-university-of-posts-and-telecomm.name: NJUPT International Students Scholarship (general and special)
nanjing-university-of-posts-and-telecomm.coverage: Tuition-linked awards: e.g. master's 10,000-15,000, PhD special 1,000-2,000 RMB/month
nanjing-university-of-posts-and-telecomm.description: Revised university rules: general scholarships tied to tuition by degree level and class; special monthly stipend awards for outstanding PhD students.
nanjing-university-of-posts-and-telecomm.eligibility: Obey law and university rules, meet course requirements, pay fees and register on time; graduate applicants need a professor recommendation.
nanjing-university-of-posts-and-telecomm.how_to_apply: New students apply via International Cooperation and Exchanges; continuing students via the College of Overseas Education, with form, notarized diploma and medical form.

zhejiang-gongshang-university.name: ZJSU General Scholarship for International Students
zhejiang-gongshang-university.coverage: Tuition-linked awards for new and current degree students
zhejiang-gongshang-university.description: University merit award with separate tracks for newly admitted and current degree students; amounts are confirmed by the admissions office.
zhejiang-gongshang-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy; new students need good prior records; current students need no arrears, 80% attendance, all exams passed.
zhejiang-gongshang-university.how_to_apply: New students apply in the online system and pick the ZJSU General Scholarship; current students submit materials to their college.

zhejiang-gongshang-university.name: ZJSU President Scholarship
zhejiang-gongshang-university.coverage: A-level and B-level awards for master's/doctoral applicants
zhejiang-gongshang-university.description: Award for strong new master's and doctoral applicants; amounts set by the admissions office.
zhejiang-gongshang-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese; bachelor's/master's degree held; prior average generally above 80; Belt and Road applicants favored; no other scholarship.
zhejiang-gongshang-university.how_to_apply: Apply online, choose the ZJSU President Scholarship, with two professor recommendation letters.

shanghai-university-of-traditional-chine.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (SHUTCM)
shanghai-university-of-traditional-chine.coverage: Class A: tuition, dorm, insurance, stipend; Class B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-university-of-traditional-chine.description: Shanghai municipal award for international students, applied for through the university.
shanghai-university-of-traditional-chine.eligibility: Age caps 25 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (PhD); language requirement; not usually combinable with other funding.
shanghai-university-of-traditional-chine.how_to_apply: Apply at apply.shutcm.edu.cn with degree proof, transcript, 1,000+ word plan, recommendations, HSK if needed.

southwest-university.name: SWU President Scholarship
southwest-university.coverage: Type A: tuition + stipend 1,100-1,700 RMB/month; Type B: tuition
southwest-university.description: University award; Type A adds monthly stipend by level, both include medical insurance; renewed after a yearly review.
southwest-university.eligibility: GPA 3.0/4.0 or 80/100; language certificate (HSK/TOEFL/IELTS); no other scholarship.
southwest-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at swu.17gz.org, Jan 1 - Jun 15 each year.

southwest-university.name: SWU New Silk Road Scholarship
southwest-university.coverage: Type A: tuition + stipend 1,100-1,700 RMB/month; Type B: tuition
southwest-university.description: For Belt and Road students with a joint project or agreement with SWU.
southwest-university.eligibility: Belt and Road nationality with SWU project; GPA 3.0/4.0; language certificate; no other scholarship.
southwest-university.how_to_apply: Apply online at swu.17gz.org, Jan 1 - Jun 15 each year.

southwest-university.name: Chongqing Mayor Scholarship
southwest-university.description: Chongqing government funds awards at SWU by degree level.
southwest-university.eligibility: First class: freshmen holding President or New Silk Road Type B; second class: self-funded freshmen.
southwest-university.how_to_apply: Select the scholarship when applying; same process as SWU awards.
